articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network based Framework for Automatic Lung Cancer Detection from Lung CT Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the major causes of death across the globe. Medical interventions with modern healthcare facilities are widely used to cure lung cancer. However, it is indispensable to have research on early detection of lung cancer as it has potential to save lives of people. With innovations in machine learning Computer Aided Design (CAD) systems for automatic detection of lung cancer has become an important solution. Particularly deep learning models such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is found to have necessary mechanisms to learn features from Computed Tomography (CT) scan images and detect the probability of lung cancer. In this paper, we propose a CNN based model for automatic detection of lung cancer provided lung CT scan image. We proposed an algorithm known as CNN based Automatic Lung Cancer Detection (CNN-ALCD) which is based on supervised learning phenomenon. The learned model is capable of detecting lung cancer from any newly arrived test sample. The proposed solution has different mechanisms such as preprocessing, building CNN with different layers, training the CNN model and performing lung cancer detection. Empirical study revealed that the proposed CNN based model outperforms many existing neural network-based methods with highest accuracy 94.11%. Therefore, the proposed system can be integrated with a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) in healthcare units for automatic diagnosis of lung cancer.

articleTitle: Wild Animal Detection using a Machine Learning Approach and Alerting using LoRa Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: It is crucial to effectively and consistently monitor wild animals in the vicinity of the forest boundaries. In this paper, an algorithm is demonstrated to identify wild animals in order to protect them. Since there are so many different kinds of animals, manually recognizing them might be challenging. To better effectively monitor animals, this system categorizes them based on their images. Animal monitoring, theft prevention, and animal-vehicle accident prevention can all be aided by animal detection and classification. Applying efficient deep learning techniques can help with this. When an animal is detected, an alert will be sent to another device through LoRa communication because standard communications like WiFi and GSM technologies may not be available in the remote sensing area. Computer vision using Python is utilized for image processing. Raspberry Pi development board is used where the model is deployed and live streaming is processed to detect a wild animal which will differentiate between Humans and Domestic animals. Once, a wild animal is detected an alert is sent through LoRa communication to an end-user who is monitoring the wildlife.

articleTitle: IoT for Enabling Smart Environment System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The concept of smart living aims at optimizing the surroundings for ease-of-use, and ease-of-installation. IoT is the fourth phase in the evolution of the Internet, which aims at ‘digitizing the world’. This was preceded by ‘digitize access’, ‘digitize business’, ‘digitize interaction’. A smart city allows us to remotely monitor, manage, and control devices, as well as generate actionable information and new insights from massive streams of real-time data. This paper aims to provide a brief overview of various components of an ideal smart city such as smart home, smart economy, smart gyms and finesse, smart office, smart campus, and smart governance.

articleTitle: Incremental Machine Learning Model for Fetal Health Risk Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: One of the significant health problems around the globe is associated with neonatal mortality or morbidity and disability in later life. The primary cause of neonatal death is preterm labor, which accounts for less than a half percent of all deaths among children under five years. Continuous monitoring and risk prediction could help provide medical assistance to the pregnant woman at the right time, substantially reducing neonatal mortality. We conducted a detailed data analysis and comparative study on various machine learning models on the cardiotocography dataset to conclude on a better accuracy of preterm birth prediction. This paper proposes an incremental learning approach to predict preterm labor risk. The response time for the medical aid can be significantly reduced using this incremental edge learning.

articleTitle: Design & Simulation of DC Fast Charging Algorithms for Battery Charging
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Battery Charging Infrastructure is one of the key important factor in future energy storage system & electric vehicle. As, AC charger takes minimum 4–5 hrs to charge electric vehicle. So, achieving less charging time to charge the battery is very challenging. This paper introduces a design & modeling of constant current & constant voltage charging algorithms together to charge the battery using DC Fast charger for electric vehicle within very short span of the time to charge. It uses an 80% state of charge (SoC) as a threshold to apply constant current & constant voltage charging algorithms. The proposed method is validated through extensive simulations in the Matlab-Simulink environment and result indicate that the proposed design algorithm provides less & fast charging time to charge the battery.

articleTitle: A study of wireless network evolution from 4G to 5G: standalone vs non-standalone
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: 5th Generation mobile network standards are finalized and 5G network rollouts have started across various operators. Some operator have different kind of existing 4G networks while some are green field deployments. To fulfill urgent rollout of 5G some operators have done non-Stand Alone deployment. This paper presents a baseline of 4G architecture with various interfaces. The 5G architecture is also presented along with key nodes of 5G. A detailed analysis regarding 5G deployment strategy along with comparison of Stand Alone and Non Stand Alone deployment strategy is presented with a suggested potential path for operators having existing 4G networks to move towards 5G network.

articleTitle: DGA Based Ensemble learning and Random Forest Models for Condition Assessment of Transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: One of the most common and significant components in the energy sector is power transformers. In a transformer, we use oil which has four applications as electric insulation medium, cooling objective, diagnostic goal, and defense against chemical attack. Transformer's dissolved gas analysis (D.G.A.) is the most extensively used technique that achieves the diagnostic goal of identifying early insulation issues. However, the DGA fault interpretation using processing methods has significant obstacles due to the minimal data availability, considerable vagueness in DGA interpretation, applicability, and model performance. It is necessary to comprehend the impact of data preparation and databalancing on the DGA database as a potential issue to upgrade the current model to the industry. This work uses vast, extremely diverse DGA data samples of in-service transformers from several sites in Himachal Pradesh, India, to create a practical methodology for fault classification. In this condition interpretation work, we analyze various parameters of DGA outputs and assess the state of the oil. A total of 421 DGA test databases were collected, and we trained the various algorithmic models in machine learning to predict the condition of oil. The best model's hyper-parameters are further tweaked for the most accurate fault categorization.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Classification of Intracranial Hemorrhages in a 3-Channel CT image by using a Transfer Learning based DenseNet121 model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Immediate detection of the kind of intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) and subsequent treatment is required for individuals with brain hemorrhages to have a better chance of survival. Deep learning models have been demonstrated to be extremely competent in supporting doctors in the classification of cerebral hemorrhages. This paper evaluates the DenseNet121 model using the transfer learning concept. The database consists of a total of 26383 CT images with different types of ICH including normal scans. The performance results on the validation data were an accuracy of 94.8%, a precision of 94.9%, a recall of 81.4%, an F1 score of 87.2%, and a ROC under AUC of 99.1% respectively. The results ensure that the proposed model has reached a higher accuracy when compared to the other models.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Charging Station for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Eco-friendly automotive technologies like electric cars have risen in popularity due to the need for a cleaner environment. In addition to the growing number of EVs, charging infrastructure is becoming more crucial. Options for increasing operation and efficiency of the EV charging infrastructure, understanding current EV customers' charging habits are some of the concerns. With RFID (radio frequency identification), users may be identified automatically. This technique employs electromagnetic waves to send and receive data. This study reports on the development of distributed renewable power charging stations for EVs. IEC 61851, 62196, and ISO 15118 are used to develop this. As controller and EV user identification, the designed electric charging station employed ATMEGA8535 microcontroller and RFID. Solar, wind, and battery storage charging stations successfully designed for electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis with NLP on Twitter Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Sentiment analysis has been widely used in a variety of fields in the previous decade, including business, social media, and education. The usage of sentiment analysis is rising, but it remains problematic, particularly in the education area, where, dealing with and processing students' thoughts is a difficult task. Several studies of the literature illustrate the current state of sentiment analysis application in this sector from various perspectives and settings. To address classification difficulties, traditional machine learning methods are commonly utilized. These machine learning techniques are frequently biased toward a specific class. The problem of sentiment categorization on the Twitter dataset is addressed in this research. In this research, we look into the problem of sentiment categorization using a Twitter dataset. We present a By including semantics in feature vectors and utilizing ensemble methods, we use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to improve sentiment classification. Increasing the accuracy of prediction by includes semantically comparable terms and context-sense identities in the feature vectors to accomplish sentiment analysis, we employ a range of text preprocessing and Naive Bayes classifier approaches. Finally, we utilize an accuracy classifying technique of diverse text preprocessing to get a classification accuracy of 77.26 percent.

articleTitle: Citrus Fruit and Leaf Disease Detection Using DenseNet
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Citrus plants are high in Vitamin <tex>$C$</tex>, which has several health benefits and is used as a raw material in a wide range of agro-industrial processes. The ripple effects of citrus fruit diseases are recognized to have a considerable impact on citrus fruit production. This is why it is critical to build a detection method for these diseases. Deep learning techniques have made it possible to execute a variety of tasks linked to the recognition of leaf and citrus diseases. In this paper we have proposed DenseNet-121 model, which tries to compare healthy leaves and fruits with those infected with citrus diseases like black spot, greening, scab, and canker. This model may extract many attributes from its various layers. The results showed that the model performs well on a variety of criteria. In 50 epochs and five classes, we achieved 96% accuracy reducing degradation and vanishing gradient problems using the ImageNet pre-trained DenseNet-121 model.

articleTitle: Analysis of Trending NFTs using Time-Series Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The financial ecology has changed thanks to blockchain technology. The first known instance of blockchain may be found in a 2008 whitepaper written by a person using the alias Satoshi Nakamoto. Non-Fungible Tokens, or NFTs, are a blockchain product that has attracted a lot of public interest. A NFT is a digital property that is implemented via blockchain. It is used to prove ownership and authenticity as it cannot be duplicated, replaced, or divided. An NFT's ownership is documented in the blockchain and is transferrable by the owner, enabling the sale and trading of NFTs. Through this paper we try to establish a relationship between NFT value and various factors such as social media, OpenSea data and so on. We aim to achieve this by using Support Vector Machine, Recurrent Neural Networks, Regression for accurate results. Thus, predicting the value of the NFT precisely.

articleTitle: Analysis of Maximum Power Point Tracking System Using P&O and INC Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper attempts to investigate and analyse two different MPPT approaches. The goal of maximum power point tracking algorithms, sometimes known as MPPT, is to obtain the maximal power from a PV source. Perturb and observe, and Incremental Conductance. MPPT algorithms are investigated and reviewed in this paper. Along with this, the necessity of renewable energy and its various sources is highlighted, as well as a thorough examination of solar power. Modelling the MPPT system, analyzing and interpreting simulation results, and demonstrating their positive behavior are all done in the MATLAB Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Potato Leaf Disease Detection Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: During the growth season, several illnesses can affect plants. One of the most significant issues in agriculture is the early diagnosis of plant diseases. Diseases can diminish total yields and farmers' income if they are not identified early enough. Reducing plant diseases and enhancing the quality and yield of food crops can both benefit from early and accurate analysis and identification of plant diseases. Since there aren't any potato disease experts in remote places, an automated, affordable, usable, and trustworthy method is needed to diagnose plant diseases without the use of laboratory testing or expert judgement. To overcome this problem, many researchers have presented approaches based on deep learning and machine learning. However, most of these systems either use millions of training parameters or have poor classification accuracy. In this paper, we provide a model for automatic plant disease identification based on convolutional neural networks (CNN). To categories potato leaves into his three classes-healthy leaves, early blight and late blight. CNN devised a methodology. This work makes use of 5162 original image dataset and 82,592 augmented images. CNN models have a classification accuracy of 98.07% and can automatically learn features from raw photos. Convolutional neural networks (CNN) and other deep learning techniques can be used to detect plant illnesses.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of FinFET-Based Static Random Access Memory Design
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The short-channel effect (SCE) limits the performance of planar MOSFET devices in conventional complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS) technologies due to the ongoing scaling (SCE). FinFETs, Nanowire, and Nanosheet devices are examples of multi-gate FETs (MuG-FETs), which have emerged as the most promising method for extending CMOS scaling past sub-22 nm technology. One of the crucial parts of CPUs is SRAM. This paper provides a comparative analysis of various SRAM designs using CMOS and FinFET devices. The performance of SRAM design is evaluated using propagation delay, power dissipation, and power delay product (PDP).

articleTitle: Design of Low Power N-Bridge Master and P-Bridge Slave Topologically Arranged Flip-Flop
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This work presents a new flip-flop design. This design is achieved using two bridge structures. Master of the flip-flop consists N-bridge and slave of the flip-flop includes P-bridge. This design is constructed using 22 transistors symmetrically. Master and slave both have 11 and 11 transistors respectively. By using this design power consumption is reduced significantly. Delay of the circuit optimized for high speed application. Percent improved with respect to Clock to Output (Q) delay and Power consumption are 7.01% and 14.8% respectively, with respect to S2CFF.

articleTitle: Exploratory Data Analysis for Interpreting Model Prediction using Python
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Data insights are being thoroughly utilized by more innovative applications, which have an impact on every sector and field of study. The tools and processes powering this change, from analyzing the enormous amounts of data generated daily to learning from and taking appropriate action, are at its foundation. Python has been the most dominant choice for data science and machine learning (ML), and using low-level libraries in Python promotes both quality and productivity. ML is frequently viewed more widely as a branch of science that focuses on creating computer models and algorithms that can carry out particular tasks, often involving pattern recognition, without the need for explicit coding. This paper focuses on the interrelationship between the use of Python in conjugation with data science and machine learning algorithms. The Data Science tools such as data summary followed by exploratory data analysis (EDA) applied on Iris Data set to output train an optimized model for future prediction yielding remarkable accuracy.

Author Keywords: Data Science and Machine Learning using Python

articleTitle: Devanagari Script Digit Classification using modified AlexNet with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Digitization of ancient scripts is more important to make available for future generations. Devanagari script is the most popular ancient Indian literature of India. Over the last decade the researcher focusing on Devanagari script digit classification. This paper presents Devanagari script digit classification using modified AlexNet with transfer learning. The pre-trained AlexNet 23rd and 25th layers modified for the requirement of Devanagari script digit data. The proposed model employs a dataset from the Kaggle and Stochastic Gradient Descent with a momentum optimizer employed for training. The proposed model shows impressive results in terms of accuracy of 93.64%.

articleTitle: V/F Controlled Three-phase Two-level Inverter Fed PMSM Drives for Wide Speed Range Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The V/F control provides the advantage of starting the motor at a low speed and increasing the speed slowly up to the rated speed. The purpose of this work is to present the use of V/F-controlled three-phase two-level PMSM drives capable of operating at a wide range of speeds. A simple duty ratio-controlled V/F where both the magnitude and frequency of the modulating signal were varied as a function of duty ratio was proposed and implemented in Matlab 2021b. From the simulation results, it was seen that the method was effective over a wide speed range. The verification of the proposed scheme is done using Opal-RT (OP4500).

articleTitle: Prediction of Mental Health of Aged Persons based on their Nervous System using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In recent years, Deep Learning (DL) has exhibited prevalent accomplishments in numerous data-rich applications, including healthcare. This work presents a high accuracy deep learning model to detect Schizophrenia or bipolar disorder or neither of them i.e., healthy. This work fosters a productive algorithm to perceive whether an individual is suffering from Schizophrenia disorder or bipolar disorder or is healthy. First, a sequential model was built to understand how accurate the model is in predicting the mental health of aged persons. Using this knowledge, the VGG-16 model is implemented to improve the accuracy of prediction. The limitations of this model are identified and to tackle the limitations VGG-19 model is utilized. The accuracy of the models carried out is obtained as Sequential: 86.05%, VGG-16: 92.10%, and VGG-19: 94.78%, and the developed proved to give better results with 94.78% accuracy using the VGG-19 model.

articleTitle: Time Series based Short term Load Forecasting using Prophet for Distribution system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: One of the threats to reliable power supply from power systems is unpredictable load demand. Thus, precise load prediction is essential. Machine Learning and Data Analytics are recommended methods. A time series forecasting approach is used to predict future load demand levels with a high degree of confidence. The Prophet tool developed by Facebook is used in the process. The prediction model is developed using real-time hourly data from HESCOM for a stipulated time interval. The effect of various seasonality, climatic parameters like temperature, humidity, and precipitation is also considered. The model developed is assessed by the values of RMSE, MAE and R2.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach for Skin Melanoma Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Melanoma is the most fatal type of malignant skin cancer, posing a serious threat to people's physical health. If melanoma of the skin is detected early, the chances of survival are very high. Dermoscopic images can be used to make an early diagnosis. Dermoscopy magnifies the skin, allowing dermatologists to better evaluate morphological features that are not easy to see with the naked eye. Machine learning is now an important technique for detecting various types of skin cancers. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has the potential to greatly assist dermatologists in the diagnosis of melanoma accurately. This paper uses a machine learning based approach to detect benign and malignant forms of skin cancer in dermoscopic images. The EfficientNet CNN model used here can design the appropriate network architecture to extract features with greater better accuracy and efficiency. The model is evaluated using dataset from the ISIC Archive.

articleTitle: Handwritten Telugu Vowel Character Classification Using Modified 25-Layer AlexNET With Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Due to remarkable performance, deep neural networks have gained popularity in computer vision and machine learning applications such as regression, segmentation, classification, detection, and pattern recognition over the past few years. This paper examines the categorization of handwritten telugu vowel characters using a modified 25-layer AlexNET and transfer learning approach. The six-class Handwritten Telugu vowel dataset from Kaggle is utilized in this experiment. To accommodate the required amount of vowel dataset classes, the 23rd and 25th layers of pre-trained AlexNET are adjusted. Training makes advantage of stochastic gradient descent using momentum optimizer. The proposed model accurately classified handwritten telugu vowel characters with a remarkable 99.72 % accuracy.

Author Keywords: stochastic gradient descent using momentum optimizer

articleTitle: Analysis of Highway Routing Protocols for VANETS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs) are the future networks of mobile ad-hoc networks. They provide communication between Vehicle to Vehicle (V2V), Vehicle to Infrastructure (V2I), and Vehicle to other entities (V2X). It creates a network infrastructure for the vehicles on roads or highways to share the information among the vehicles and other entities. The information may be related to safety transportation, traffic, alert messages and user related information. To provide the seamless communication services, VANETs pose many issues such as mobility, prediction of abnormal situations, routing, scalability, privacy issues, location dependency, network density, power constraints and information access. Among these issues routing plays a significant role in the VANET communication for quick response time. The routing provides effective communication between the vehicles and other entities. Authors of this article aim to provide survey on highway routing protocols used in urban area VANETs. Comparative study is conducted to explore the features of routing protocols like Optimized Link State Routing (OLSR), Dynamic Source Routing (DSR), Ad-hoc On Demand Distance Vector (AODV), and Destination Sequence Distance Vector (DSDV). The experimental results show AODV is better than others. The protocols are analysed using performance parameters like throughput, delay, packet delivery ratio (PDR) and network overhead.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of EV Charging Station using PV Integrated Battery Sytsem
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With 21<sup>st</sup> century facing major predicament towards global warming and major actions being taken in this direction to avoid further appalling situations has led OEMs for drastic adoption of EVs and PHEVs. An advent towards EVs in this direction leads to swift requirements of EV charging networks. Using conventional sources to charge the millions of future EVs on road will further aggravate the cause as these energy sources use fossil fuel as their prime feed with harmful emissions as by-product. Solar energy being most abundantly and easily available, with a total solar irradiance of 3.8 million exajoule, which goes unharnessed by humans, it becomes a paramount source of energy for charging vehicles. As time of charging is one of the major concerns of EV charging, this paper proposes design of efficient charging system and in-depth study of solar irradiance, battery, load demands, SOC with efficient MPPT P&O algorithm for fast charging of batteries which could be used to make EVs a more lucrative alternative among the rest. All the various graphs and parameters have been simulated in SIMULINK environment of MATLAB.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Butterworth, Chebyshev, and Elliptic filter for Harmonic Mitigation using P-Q based SAPF
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The majority of industries use controllers; adjustable speed drives and more and more smart appliances are being used in residences. These types of equipment draw non-sinusoidal currents from the supply causing supply voltage to also become non-sinusoidal. This results in harmonic distortion. Harmonics affects the loads which cause it as well as the other loads connected to the same utility which affects their operation. The utilities should supply harmonic-free power to all the loads connected to them. Shunt Active Power Filters are now being widely used to reduce harmonic distortion. Shunt Active Power Filter based on P-Q theory is simulated in MATLAB / SIMULINK and its performance is checked for different low pass filters like Butterworth, Chebyshev II, and Elliptic. Also, controlled rectifier-based R L loads are used and the performance is checked for different firing angles of the controlled rectifier.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network Based Automatic Detection and Classification of Lung Nodules from CT images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The main cause of mortality globally is cancer, with lung cancer being the most common among all cancer types. Radiologists use computer tomography (CT) scans to detect and monitor cancer in the body. Due to subjectivity, visual complexity, and wide variances among interpreters, human professionals ability to interpret images is relatively restricted. Consequently, early cancer detection using image processing techniques is possible. Image segmentation and the extraction of radiomic features from CT scans are the two main components of image processing. Deep learning is currently offering innovative, highly authentic solutions for medical imaging and is recognized as a crucial technique for upcoming applications in the health sector as a result of its success in other real-world applications. A a deep learning model along with image processing techniques is proposed for detecting lung cancer. SPIE-AAPM Lung CT Challenge dataset is used for this study. The proposed Deep Learning Model based Lung Cancer Detection (DLMLCD) achieves an accuracy of 99% on evaluation of the above dataset.

articleTitle: Outage Probability and Average Sum Rate of an IoT enabled D2D Communication Network in LTE Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is a concept which forms a giant network of all connected things and people. To interconnect the IoT devices (IoTDs), Device-to-Device (D2D) communication is considered a key technology that allows the proximity services (ProSe) i.e., direct communication between two Device User Equipment (DUE) without unnecessary routing through network infrastructure, and also utilizes the existing cellular bands, resulting in low latency and spectrum efficiency. In this paper our objective is to provide connectivity between the IoTDs lying inside the poor coverage region and their associated IoT Gateway (IoT-GW) using D2D communication underlying Long Term Evolution (LTE) network. We have simulated the model and investigated the impact on overall Outage Probability of the communication link for different parameters. We have also investigated the Average Sum Rate (ASR) of the system network for different number of IoTDs.

articleTitle: Intelligent Explosivity Prediction of Underground Coal Mines using a Deep Parametrised Residual RNN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Underground mining poses various life-threatening and hazardous threats to mineworkers. The most prominent of these is the methane explosion. However, the recurrence of these events can be reduced with appropriate monitoring of indicator gases such as carbon monoxide, oxygen, and methane. A new parameterised residual recurrent neural network model is proposed in this article to forecast the indicator gases to predict the atmosphere's explosivity. Thereafter, for the performance assessment, the model is contrasted with various relatively less complex models, such as LSTM, RNN, and ANN. Grahm's ratio is used for calculating atmosphere explosivity using forecasted gas concentrations. The proposed model can predict the next day's explosivity of the underground atmosphere using the past seven days' data with a significantly high R2 score of 0.98. The suggested framework can assist in preparing the safety management strategies before the event's occurrence.

articleTitle: Webcam based Secure Surveillance system for the smart agriculture using Raspberry pi
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Internet of things (IoT)is the integration of embedded system, sensors and actuators with the internet so whole setup can be access and controlled remotely using internet on your mobile or PC. The integration of IoT in human life is going to increase day by day. Deployment of IoT in agriculture sector will enhance its potential by continuous monitoring of agricultural field through the mobile application and storage of the data on cloud will help to make it better for future. In agriculture, proper irrigation is the crucial task. Data on cloud is important for the successful implementation and security of that data from hacking is the key. This paper is presenting secured system architecture for the agriculture field with integration of webcam and sensors for the surveillance. So that a farmer can keep track of their field at any time in day and night with the live tracking through webcam. The pictures captured by the webcam will be mailed to the farmer which accessible to the concern farmer only as it is password protected.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Object Detection and Classification for Future Multi-Media Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Object detection is a very important aspect of multimedia applications. The recent innovations that are being deployed in the current era with the latest trends in technological advancements have made researchers and scientists develop systems that are capable of identifying objects using various machine learning algorithms. The objects that are being identified are further classified for identifying the particular class of the object. This process seems to be simple but is quite complex and also has various complexities and complications that need to be analyzed before deploying any algorithm into the machine for automated detection and classification. This paper explores the recent research that is carried out, in particular in the area of object detection and classification using machine learning algorithms. The performance measures like accuracy, sensitivity, recall, and F-measures have been compared with the available model.

articleTitle: EfficientNet-B3 and Image Processing for Monkeypox Detection using Skin Lesion Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Monkeypox is the dominant topic of discussion in the scientific and popular press around the world right now. Machine learning (ML) has recently shown enormous potential for image-based diagnoses like COVID-19 patient screening and cancer detection. Since the disease is related to monkeypox and has affected human skin, a similar approach can be used to diagnose it. Images of the disease can then be obtained and used to confirm the diagnosis. This study proposes and evaluates several deep learning models - ResNet50, EfficientNet-B3, VGG16, and InceptionNetV3. An image-based dataset has been used from Kaggle, and data augmentation is performed to expand the sample size. The highest accuracy of 93% from EfficientNet-B3 was obtained upon execution of the pre-trained models. A diverse data set would result in more accurate and appropriate results.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems in Smart Environments – A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Intrusions in networks are considered to be an activity occurring on digital networks in an illegal manner. They steal the network's confidential data and resources in the which in turn degrades the network security and/or data security. By detecting and preventing these intrusion attacks, one can avoid malicious activities happening inside the network beforehand, analyze the quantity and types of attacks which might happen in the network and prevent it in advance. Intrusion detection and Prevention systems (IDPS) are being employed in various laboratories, industries, and public service organizations. Security controls to various enterprises and organizations can be provided and performance of IoT based smart environments can be improved. In this article, a detailed survey about how the intrusion attacks happen in smart environments, ways to detect and prevent them are discussed. Different types of IDS and IPS, Future research directions, challenges and scope of the work are outlined in this work.

articleTitle: Airline Twitter Sentiment Classification using Deep Learning Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Since the advent of the Internet, the way people express their ideas and beliefs has undergone significant transformation. Blogs, online forums, product review websites and social media are increasingly the primary means of distributing information about new products. Twitter, in particular, is giving people a platform to air their views and opinions about a variety of events and products. In order to continually enhance the quantity and quality of their products and services, entrepreneurs constantly need input from their customers. Businesses are always looking for ways to increase the quality of their products and services. As a result, it's tough to understand the consumer's sentiments because of the large volume of data. In this research work, a Kaggle dataset of airline tweets for sentiment analysis was used. The dataset contains 11,540 reviews. We proposed an ensemble CNN, LSTM architecture for sentiment analysis. For comparison of the proposed system, LSTM alone also tested for similar dataset. LSTM was given an accuracy of 91% and the proposed ensemble framework with LSTM and CNN was given an accuracy of 93%. The experiments showed that the proposed model achieved better accuracy when compared to conventional techniques.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Approaches for Text Quality Prediction using Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The popularity of developer support forums is rising. Although open-source knowledge is a precious resource for many developers, there may be challenges with the standard of the information obtained. The advancement of semantic segmentation systems has expanded quickly in response to the unprecedented growth of digital resources. The quality of questions, comments, answers, and views are difficult to distinguish on the Q&A platforms like Stack Overflow, Bloom Fire, Answer Hub, Quora, Yahoo, etc. The automatic extraction of expressive features is made possible by recently developed machine learning algorithms, which take advantage of the most important innovations in advanced learning techniques. The technological increase in these approaches has spawned a wide range of approaches for encoding natural language into machine-interpretable data. In this paper, an in-depth examination of these methodologies used to solve quality-related problems is done. Algorithms like Logistic Regression, Multiple Linear Regression, Fully CNN, Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, FastText Classifier, and BiLSTM are studied and analyzed. Lastly, a relative analysis is achieved primarily focused totally on innovative consequences obtained from specific methods.

articleTitle: Decentralized Image Sharing App using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: While the rise of social media swept the globe, in recent years, a discussion concerning the technology's ramifications has gained traction. Two key concerns, in particular, are concerns about user privacy and data, as well as concerns about centralized authority, including censorship. Because these two areas are directly related to the technical issues that decentralization addresses, there is a growing interest in blockchain-based data-sharing multimedia applications such as Instagram. This application prototypes a clone of Instagram, where the users can earn tokens for likes, shares comments on their posts. Their posts are copyright protected and similar duplicate posts will be detected.

articleTitle: Data Integrity Cyber-attack Mitigation using LQR based Controller in Multi-area Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The power system, today, utilises various communication technologies for its reliable operation. Notable steady state operations are load frequency regulation, system integrity protection, optimal power flow, and contingency analysis. Use of communication technologies, however, make the modern power system prone to cyber threats which can sometimes lead to major grid failures. Load frequency control (LFC) is one such critical operation which depends on the high speed, yet vulnerable, communication channel. Cyber threats may occur in various forms such as Data integrity attack, Denial of service, Random attack etc. A conventional two-area thermal power plant is being studied for frequency response during data integrity cyber-attack. Frequency deviation, while adopting conventional integral controller is compared with the Linear quadratic regulator (LQR) based control methodology. It is seen that LQR based methodology effectively controls frequency deviation and also shows satisfactory results when subjected to varied type of load disturbance in regular time intervals. The same is being demonstrated through state space analysis using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Two-Stage Interleaved Boost Converter for EV Battery Charging Using Hybrid Power Sources
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This work presents a novel technique to charge EV Li-ion battery using hybrid power sources. Solar energy in combination with dc power is utilized to charge EV Battery. A dc-dc power converter is designed so as to ensure operation of PV array at Maximum Power Point. The main objective is to utilize PV panel to maximum extent while the dc source acts as stand-by, supplying the energy difference between the PV panel and the battery. The converter is modeled using state space analysis and verified for operational stability. The capability of the technique to charge EV batteries of different sizes is verified using MATLAB/Simulink.

Author Keywords: Double Input Single Output(DISO) interleaved power converter

articleTitle: An Image-Based Hashtag Recommendation System as a Social Media Workflow Tool
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Social Media is an obligatory choice to make for businesses in today's age to grow their brand. Attaining maximum reach on social media is pivotal for any business to gain consumers. This growth is directly proportional to the manner in which the business handles their social media. Hashtags are supposed to be extremely vital on social media platforms like Twitter, Instagram for easy retrieval, categorization and engagement of posts. But most businesses fail to make most of the benefits offered by usage of appropriate hashtags. Hence, in this research work we suggest a novel approach to recommend hashtags for image-based posts on social platforms using Deep Learning techniques. We also provide an in-depth methodology to build the essential dataset from scratch and develop the model for a real time web-based application. The proposed methodology has also been compared to a few other alternative approaches that we took. The experimental results showcase that our proposed approach is greatly significant in terms of providing hashtags for best reach as well as most suited to the post's image.

articleTitle: Trapezoidal Speed Control of BLDC Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In the past few years, the brushed direct current motors are being replaced by brushless direct current (BLDC) motors. This is mainly because BLDC motors have higher efficiency, speed and torque. In order to drive a BLDC motor a control circuit is required. Frequently used control circuit is an inverter. There are two types of speed control techniques using control circuit for BLDC motor namely 120° square-wave commutation and 180° sinusoidal commutation. The 120° square-wave commutation also known as trapezoidal commutation, is easy to implement and has less cost as compared to 180° sinusoidal commutation. In trapezoidal commutation, the current is controlled through two terminals of the motor and the third terminal is disconnected from the power source. This paper presents the 120° square-wave commutation for speed control of BLDC motor using SEMIKRON inverter, TI's Launchpad F28069M and Altair embed (VisSim) software. The results of the speed control are evaluated and verified using experimental results. Simplicity and low-cost operation are the advantages of this control strategy.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Microstrip Patch Antenna for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A microstrip antenna is suggested in this study for use in close-range biomedical applications. Miniaturization and biocompatibility are the key design considerations for this proposed antenna. It is also important to conserve energy to increase the lifespan of the medical device. Operating in the Medical spectrum (ISM) is the implantable antenna. The proposed antenna bandwidth is 916 MHz which covers the ISM band. At the 2.4 GHz resonance frequency, the simulated return loss is −25.79 dB. By using the microstrip feed line approach, microstrip antenna analysis and design are carried out. The return loss, VSWR, bandwidth, and radiation pattern are determined from the simulation results by using CST software.

articleTitle: Low Power High-Speed Optimized Comparator for Flash ADC
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents an optimized latch-based Comparator architecture for 70–75 MS/s, 8-bit, CMOS Analog to Digital Converter (ADC). To achieve enhanced performance specifications of the latch-based comparator, the design specifications of the comparator are modified up to optimum levels hence flash ADC architecture. Resulting in limiting power dissipation and delay of comparator i.e., 0.21mW and 4.36ns respectively are achieved. Subsequently, the sampling speed 150MHz (min.) at an analog power supply of 2V with a total power consumption of 7.27mW at full speed is achieved. The modified preamplifier architecture scales down the power consumption and supply of the entire ADC architecture as well. The comparator is implemented using a <tex>$\boldsymbol{0.35\mu} \mathbf{m}$</tex> CMOS technology node using the Cadence Virtuoso tool.

articleTitle: Envisioning Reliable Diagnosis of Diabetic Retinopathy using U-Net Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: For the semantic and instance segmentation of biomedical data, deep neural networks perform better than conventional techniques. However, the computational cost of this approach is high. After training, the network can be made simpler, or an acceptable architecture that offers segmentation with lower accuracy but faster can be selected, lowering the computational cost. We looked into the efficacy and performance of various UNet architectures for the challenge of image segmentation in this study. With the aid of pictures from a retinopathy health survey, the DRIVE dataset was examined. Among the six different models of UNet being compared, R2-UNet delivered the most promising results in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Protection of Medical Data Using Integer Wavelet Discrete Cosine Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Telemedicine has gained a lot of popularity and recognition in the field of healthcare, as it provides medical assistance remotely by experts. As medical data is transferred through the public network, the alteration of data can be done intentionally or mistakenly by attackers or intruders which may result in the wrong diagnosis. In order to provide security to sensitive medical data, various advanced techniques are adopted. Watermarking approach is one among them which is used to protect the integrity of sensitive medical data. Thus, this paper proposed Integer Wavelet Discrete Cosine Transform (IWDCT) watermarking technique to preserve the integrity, confidentiality, and authentication of sensitive information of medical data. IWDCT has better coding performance and provides low computational time for embedding as well as extraction, and it ensures the visual quality of an image. The morphological operations were used to extract the Region of Interest (RoI) from the medical image. The workaround aim of IWDCT is to safeguard the RoI by embedding it into its Region of Non-Interest (RoNI). The integrated RoI is extracted by the reverse application of IWDCT. As a result, the intruder can only see the original image, while the RoI is interred. The accuracy of the watermarked image can be evaluated using the metrics like Peak Signal Noise to Ratio (PSNR). Because of its higher performance, the proposed mechanism can be employed in the secure transmission of medical images.

articleTitle: Dielectric Coupled Microstrip Patch Multilayered Antenna for wide scan application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents design and optimization of microstrip patch multilayered antenna. The proposed antenna is being operated in X-band with wide band and wide beam capabilities. Authors used multilayered structure with coaxial vias in order to achieve wide band and wide scan capabilities. Dielectric material of dielectric constant of 3.66 is used and antenna is optimized in the CST simulator. The presented results shows that authors are able to achieve more than 2 GHz band width and better than ± 60 deg. scan performance.

articleTitle: Prediction of Online Academic dishonesty Using the Voting Ensemble Machine Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Due to pandemics, remote tests have grown in popularity, and with the benefit of remote working circumstances, the majority of enterprises and institutions employ online platforms for assessment. Despite the high degree of test monitoring, it is extremely simple for a student to acquire third-party assistance during the exam. To defend these sorts of operations, there are relatively few models that can anticipate the zone where the likelihood of fraud is greatest. In this research, we describe an academic dishonesty detection method for online tests that is based on machine learning. This algorithm predicts if a student is cheating or acting ethically based on a study of exam data performed after the exam. In this study, we analyze a large variety of variables for predicting unethical behavior during tests, including exam mode, number of questions completed within ideal time, observed time, accurate questions within ideal time, pass criteria, likelihood of question recurrence, and exam traversal. However, for initial modelling, only eleven elements are used. To increase the accuracy, we include all remaining components. The model predicts suspicious behavior when the number of right tries within the allotted time exceeds the threshold established based on the total number of exam questions. The link between time-based parameters, accuracy, and pass criteria gov-erns the machine learning model used to forecast fraud and real situations. Combining the findings of Extreme Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost Classifier models, the suggested solution employs the “Voting Ensemble” approach of machine learning to increase the accuracy of prediction.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Various Photovoltaic Module Arrangements based on Game Puzzle Theory under PSCs: Experimental Validation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this paper, series-parallel (SP), total-cross-tied (TCT) and game puzzle dependent photovoltaic (PV) array configurations show the comprehensive results during partial shadowing conditions (PSCs). The productivity indices are investigated with respect to power and voltage at global maximum power point (GMPP), fill factor (FF), power enhancement (PE), etc. In this paper, a MATLAB/Simulink performs to develop PV system configurations and carries the extensive investigation under the shadowing conditions. Experimental study proves the obtained the simulation results and found that the Calcu-Do-Ku game puzzle based configuration has higher results in terms of GMPP as 49.29W and 60.14W compared to the conventional PV array configurations under considered both shadowing cases. The experimental study proves the results obtained through the MATLAB/results during the similar shading circumstances.

articleTitle: Detection of Toxic Gases and Temperature Sensing for Miners using IoT Based Intelligent Helmet
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Mining is a Double-edged industry, though it is essential to extract naturally occurring solid minerals, it comes with its disadvantageous risks to both the environment and humans. The immediate threats posed to the miners by underground mining often include explosions, detonations, and exposure to hazardous gasses such as Carbon monoxide (CO), Carbon Dioxide (CO2), Methane, and Hydrogen Sulfide(H2S). Some other dangers include harsh conditions of extreme temperature, pressure, and humidity, risk of damage due to low visibility, low Oxygen concentration, and the possibility of head injuries due to the presence of rubble and debris. The mining industry cannot be completely shut down as it is crucial for a nation's economy. However, the safety of our miners can be increased with the help of this proposed IoTbased intelligent helmet. In this paper, we attempt to develop a sensor-integrated intelligent helmet, which allows us to monitor the underground mine conditions. The transmission of the data is done through IoTbased ESP2866 which will be displayed on the LCD. This data can be assessed and evaluated to provoke a rescue mission when required and predict future conditions of the mine, thereby ensuring the safety of miners.

articleTitle: Development of Interactive ASL (American Sign Language) Learning App
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The ASL (American Sign Language) is one of the most used sign languages today due to the increased population of people with hearing loss and speech impediment. The interactive and fun learning platform for these individuals are less which causes communication gap between impaired and unimpaired people, trouble availing services and difficult learning sign language for abled individuals. In this paper, the basics of ASL, alphabets are animated according to the sign language using Blender software to model a 3D character and using Unity software, developed an interactive basic ASL learning app. It has features like AR (Augmented Reality) and audio for all signs which can be heard with respect to the letter typed by the user. The AR is integrated in Unity software with the Vuforia plug-in. The app was developed successfully with instant response by the 3D character model with letter input and for AR, detection of target image was found to be within seconds.

articleTitle: A Novel Shortest Path Problem using Dijkstra Algorithm in Interval-Valued Neutrosophic Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this fast-changing world, amid a global pandemic there is a need of minimizing costs in terms of time, money, and kind. We represent all our major real-life decisionmaking problems like – telecommunication, social networking, time-scheduling problems, google map, DNA mapping, shortest air/ship routes, etc. using a graph in the forms of nodes and edges. Now, from the single source node if we would like to reach the multiple nodes, we require the shortest path then we use Dijkstra's algorithm, also known as the minimization algorithm, which uses the greedy approach and gives an optimal solution. In this paper, a novel method is proposed to find the shortest path problem (SPPr) in the interval-valued neutrosophic environment, where the uncertain/indeterminate data is expressed as three independent variables i.e., truth membership, indeterminate membership, and false membership. To validate the proposed method, a hypothetical problem of road networking is solved efficiently to determine the shortest route from the multiple available routes, where the cost associated with nodes is taken as an interval-valued neutrosophic fuzzy number.

articleTitle: A Review on Forecasting Models and Anomaly Detection for Household Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Smart meters collect data from household appliances to achieve optimal energy consumption from the consumer and utility perspective. The data collected should be analyzed and processed to design an effective control structure. Detecting anomalous behaviour in the appliances becomes vital to maintain energy demands and optimize energy consumption. This article discusses energy consumption forecasting and anomaly detection, in which various statistical and intelligent methods are compared. The performance of the various forecasting models is evaluated with multiple time series evaluation metrics. Statistical forecasting models like autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) and seasonal autoregressive integrated moving averages (SARIMA) are compared with intelligent methods such as univariate long short term memory (uni-LSTM) models and multivariate long short term memory (multi-LSTM) models. From the results and analysis performed, it is concluded that the multi-LSTM models give better results and can detect anomalous behaviour more efficiently compared to their counterparts.

articleTitle: Application of Grey Clustering Algorithm in Wet-land Ecotourism Development
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In recent years, the deterioration of wetland ecological environment has received widespread attention from all walks of life, and the sudden rise of ecotourism has received widespread attention. The effective way to protect wetland ecological environment is to develop and utilize wetland eco-tourism reasonably. The main purpose of this paper is to propose and discuss the application of grey clustering algorithm in wetland eco-tourism development. This method can be used to classify and identify wetlands according to their characteristics, which will help us classify wetlands into different categories according to their characteristics. Wetland is one of the most threatened ecosystems due to human activities, such as deforestation, soil erosion and urbanization. In order to protect these valuable ecosystems and ensure the sustainable use of mankind, we need to have better.

articleTitle: Real Time Mask Detection using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the advent of Convolutional Neural Networks, the field of image classification has seen tremendous growth, with various previously impossible applications now being pursued. One such application is face mask detection, which is an important problem to solve, considering recent pandemic. The novelty of this work is the training of YOLO (You Only Look Once) framework for custom object detection, which in this case is face mask, based on some empirical rules for fine-tuning the performance. Also, image classification is proposed to be combined with tracker, in order to implement real world access grant system based on compliance shown by mask wearer.

articleTitle: Fruit Disease and Freshness Identification By Image Processing Method Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This article discusses a system that uses Raspberry PI to detect and prevent the spread of fruit illnesses. The k-avg cluster algorithm is used to analyse various images. It has several advantages for use in large agricultural farms and detects disease symptoms on fruit leaves immediately. The automatic detection of disease symptoms using image processing and the k-means cluster method is useful for tracking crops in the field of fungus and is thus an important research topic in fruit pharmaceutical research. The term “disease” refers to the type of fruit toxicity. This study presents the most effective method for identifying fruit diseases using image processing and alerting the system owner about the disease's cause by displaying the disease's name on the system owner's monitor display. Automatic disease symptom identification can help farmers improve their crops. These technologies, which are entirely automatic in their design and implementation, will be extremely useful in chemical applications. It will reduce the cost of pesticides and other goods. This will result in increased agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: Automated Individualised Remote- Accessible Medication Evaluator And Dispenser (AIRMED)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Elderly and vulnerable persons in our society are frequently on multiple medications, and need constant supervision for correct dosing of drugs. Patients with memory loss or poor comprehensive capacity may suffer complications due to the consumption of the wrong medication, multiple pill bottles, multiple medication schedules, etc which can contribute to medication errors and lead to unpleasant side effects and hospitalization. As a solution to this problem, we have developed an all-in-one care package that includes an automatic pill dispenser with proper pill dispensing and alert mechanisms which help in adequate medicine dosing as well as a heart rate monitor, sleep monitor, and fall detection sensor that can alert the contacts regarding sudden catastrophic health situations. The remote access functionality of the device enables the caretakers or doctors to make alterations in the timing and schedule of medications after consultation and can also order medicines online when supply runs short. This device aims to find a solution to complex medical management in elderly and chronically ill patients and ensure medication adherence leading to optimum health benefits while also giving immense peace of mind to loved ones.

articleTitle: Happiness Is Homemade: Website For Elderly People
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Happiness Is Homemade is a safe and trusted platform that addresses the lack of recreational opportunities faced by older adults. Our website will help people not only elders but also volunteers of younger age groups, connect with people of similar likes and interests helping them enlarge their social circle and switching to other means of recreation apart from mobile phones and television. This platform aims at resolving the issues of lack of leisure time activities which may lead to problems in physical and mental health, social life, and the environment in which they live and interact with older adults. Registered volunteers organize specific activities for senior citizens. Elders who are interested in embarking on new experiences or continue pursuing their hobbies and interests can register for the specific curated event. The event details, time, place, and the details of the volunteer/s organizing the event would be mentioned. Activities here include excursions to specific locations, temple visits, retro nights and yoga, meditation events, etc. It also provides a platform for seniors to organize courses(classes) in their areas of expertise. These courses are accompanied by interested volunteers. Classes can be conducted online or offline at senior citizens' homes. Classes can include any subject, including cooking, finance, gardening, and home economics. With the help of this platform not only will the problem of leisure time activities be resolved but also it will help the elder citizens to earn some income.

articleTitle: Steady State and Transient State Analysis of Buck-Boost Converter with Genetic Algorithm Optimized PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: DC-DC converters are used in applications such as renewable energy electronic systems, dc motor drives, charge controller for battery, etc. In the proposed method, the Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller is applied to a Buck-boost converter operating in Continuous Conduction Mode (CCM). Since machine learning is becoming increasingly important in all fields of engineering and technology, and Genetic Algorithms (GAs) have a wide range of applications in machine learning and optimization problems, the proposed method employs a GA for the optimization of DC-DC converter control parameters. The GA is used in determining the optimized parameters for PID controller and Integral of Absolute Error (IAE) is considered as the object function to minimize the estimated error. The optimization of the PID controller is performed using MATLAB Simulink software. In the simulations, the output performance parameters such as rise time, overshoot, settling time, steady-state error are estimated and overshoot of output voltage for various source and load transient conditions are analyzed to determine the performance of the proposed system. The effectiveness of the controller has been tested in both Buck and Boost mode of operations through simulation experiments. The developed GA optimized PID has shown good performance both in steady-state and transient conditions.

articleTitle: Analysis of Low Power DC-Motor Drive Control Using Fractional Order PI Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Precision motor position control is an important requirement for conveyer belt operation with distinct objects. PID controller is basically used to control the position of servomotor in real time application. However, the integral controller present in the PID loop makes the system unstable in real time application. Again PID controller consist of 3 controlling point to control the motor against vibration, position and stability point of view. In contradiction, the fractional order controller will provide additional 3 controlling point so that the robustness in the transfer function of PID controller can achieve the zero tolerance limit. The robustness of the PID controller can be determined by using either Time domain analysis or Frequency domain analysis. In this research article, an investigation has been carried out to design fractional order PI controller in the state space domain using MATLAB Simulink model. The validation of the transfer function in order to achieve precision motor control has been tested with three benchmarking model.

articleTitle: A Single Layer Frequency Selective Surface based EM Shield for 4G and 5G Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Electromagnetic (EM) Interference has become a serious issue due to increased operational frequency of the wireless devices and systems. Hence, it became essential for EM shielding to protect highly sensitive radio frequency devices. In this paper, a frequency selective surface (FSS) based EM shield for 4G and 5G mobile communication is reported due to its advantages such as compact size, frequency selectivity and high angular stability. The FSS unit cell is composed of two outer square loops and a cross dipole within square loop which is designed using fractal geometry. The overall dimension of the proposed structure is 30mmx30mmx1.6mm designed on an FR4 substrate using HFSS simulation software. The results show that the FSS shield resonates centered at 2.35 GHz and 3.5 GHz covering 4G and 5G frequency bands, respectively. The proposed design provides shielding effectiveness of about 32 dB at lower band and 33 dB at upper band frequency. The results also confirm that it has good angular stability upto 45° in both TE and TM mode polarizations.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Air Pollution Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Air pollution includes contamination of air due to harmful gases, residues, fumes, etc. Contaminated air gives rise to important issues for the solid endurance of plants, organisms and individuals, including natural life. This paper focuses on predicting air pollutants using machine learning (ML) techniques and its performance analysis. Various regression and classification models like Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest Classifier, Logistic Regression, Linear Regression and Random Forest Regression are used to optimize the air pollutants for better accuracy in forecasting. The performance of ML models is evaluated using State Pollution Control Board (SPCB) dataset, Odisha. The performance of Regression models is evaluated using Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE). It prevails in Random Forest Regression having RMSE and MAE as 2.63 and 3.32 respectively. For classification models, Random Forest Classifier precede with an accuracy of 93.5 %. The efficient performance of the model in predicting air pollutants can help in alerting the public to safer living.

articleTitle: Developing Device Driver for Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: All application-related systems will become smarter thanks to the next-generation Internet of Things (IoT) device, the Raspberry Pi. Raspberry Pi being a simple board can be used as an alternative for computers. Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and other protocols can be used by the Raspberry Pi to connect to the internet. In this essay, we've talked about procedures like initially porting the OS to the Pi board, after which the device driver took care of communicating with the system hardware. After that, the operation of the Bluetooth and Wi-Fi modules was explained. Also looked into was the use of Yocto projects.

articleTitle: Evol-AutoNN: Evolutionary Automation of Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: As the domain of data science keeps on growing it leads to the need for a tool that breaks the barriers for non-experts to get into the field of data science. In this paper, we introduce the project of automating the neural network with the Evolutionary algorithm in the name of Evol-AutoNN. Evol-AutoNN is a biomimicry approach to the prediction of tabular data using the well-known two biological concepts that came from nature. Biological Evaluation and the Neural Network that came from the human brain are the two concepts applied in this project. Biomimicry is a new procedure to do innovation that tries to give a strong solution to a human problem by mimicking the patterns identified in nature. It is developed to overcome the problem of finding the best initial setting for the neural network for a given problem by the user. Evol-AutoNN imitates the process followed in both natural selection and genetics. As such, this work entitles to be an important step in the automation of neural networks for tabular data.

articleTitle: Analysis of Stages Power in Asymmetrical Cascade H-Bridge Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Multi-level inverters (MLIs) are new generation of converters for DC-AC voltage and power conversion at medium and high levels. MLIs are divided into two types, symmetric and asymmetric, according to the value of DC voltage sources. In this study, an asymmetrical cascade H-bridge (ACH) MLI with different DC sources ratio is considered and the power between its stages is examined. Also, the harmonic of the output voltage waveform is analyzed, and the best ratio of ACH-MLI is obtained. The simulation by Simulink/MATLAB shows useful results of this study appropriate for industry design of ACH-MLIs.

articleTitle: Intelligent Quality Control System for Product Manufacturers through ML
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: One of the most important components in ensuring product quality before it reaches the market is industrial inspection. The visual system, including human vision, machine vision, or a mix of both, can be used to carry out the inspection tasks. In this research, we present a method that can regulate the product quality of press parts. Visual inspection systems are used to accomplish quality control by identifying acceptable parts from rejected goods. Complete quality control of the raw materials is a requirement for large-scale production enterprises. The primary goals are to create an image processing system that can assess a part's dimension and determine whether it should be accepted or rejected. Calculating the pixel value will yield the part's dimensions. The result shows its possibility to be used as automated visual inspection system.

articleTitle: Data Mining Technology Assists in The Construction of The Influencing Factor Model of Learners' Satisfaction in Offline Online and Offline Hybrid Golden Courses
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Constructing the influencing factor model of learners' satisfaction in mixed gold classroom is a method to determine the level of product satisfaction. The purpose of this study is to understand the effectiveness of builders in their work and how they can make their work more effective. The construction of influencing factor model is based on the following theory: price, quality, service and other factors can affect human behavior. This theory was developed by Dr. Robert J. Sternberg to explain how people make decisions when facing choices or choices (Sternberg 2006). The construction of influencing factor model assumes that decision-making involves four main components: heuristic, emotional response, cognitive process and behavioral response (Sternberg and grigoren). The main purpose of this study is to determine whether there is a relationship between constructors and student satisfaction.

articleTitle: Fast Fault Signal Acquisition Algorithm for Power Communication Equipment Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the continuous growth of the number and types of information and communication equipment, the types and numbers of faults have also begun to increase sharply. How to effectively analyze and process the fault data of information and communication equipment in order to obtain useful knowledge and assist the maintenance and management of information and communication equipment has become a key issue. The fast fault signal acquisition algorithm of power communication equipment based on wavelet transform is a new technology for fault detection of distribution system. It was developed by researchers from the Department of electrical engineering, University of Parma, Italy. The system includes an innovative receiver that uses wavelet transform to detect and filter rapidly changing signals in a noisy environment.
