In order to avoid false positives caused by random noise, it can be used with adaptive filtering technology. Even if there are multiple active faults in a short time, the receiver can provide accurate fault detection results.

articleTitle: Peak Shaving Approach of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The modern power system network comprises distributed generations of renewable sources. The intermittent nature of renewable sources may not always support the peak demand of the electricity network; therefore the integration of storage batteries can support the peak demand for retaining power system stability. The battery of fast charging loads like electric vehicles (EV), electric ferries (EF) and others can also be used for peak shaving of the power system. The storage elements can provide FCAS (frequency control ancillary service) to the power system for restoring the system's stability. To justify the peak shaving option of storage battery, a 9-bus system electrical network is created by OpenDSS which analyzes the charging and discharging characteristics of the battery. The storage controller controls the storage batteries in two modes, one follow-time (discharging and charging) mode and another load-shape (charging and discharging) mode. The storage controller controls the sequence of operation of the batteries to meet the load demand of the electrical network. The proposed approach can be used for a large electrical network to manage the peak demand to retain power system stability.

articleTitle: Ensembled Residual Network (ERN) for Gas-Hazard Prediction in the Underground Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The underground coal mines exhibit many life-threatening hazards for mining workers. In contrast, gas hazards are among the most critical challenges to handle. This paper proposes a deep neural network-based model, i.e., an ensembled residual network (ERN) for the gas hazard prediction in the underground coal mine case. The model uses two balancing parameters to integrate two different one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1DCNN) architectures. Those balancing parameters are responsible for controlling the output of both architectures. The ERN model is tested with the mine gas dataset, and the performance is compared with 1DCNN and a feed-forward deep neural network. The performance analysis of ERN for underground coal mine data is presented. An accuracy of 96.5% is achieved with an error of less than 4.7%.

articleTitle: A Bandpass Filter Based on the SISL Technology Using Open Stub and Triangular Resonator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A substrate-integrated suspended line (SISL)-based bandpass filter (BPF) is simulated in the proposed work. One transmission zero (TZ) is introduced in the design using a triangular ring resonator with an open stub. The rejection band is further extended using a pair of square split ring resonators coupled with the main structure. The simulated result of the SISL BPF shows a center frequency of 3 GHz with a 3 dB bandwidth of 462 MHz. The insertion loss at the center frequency is 0.11 dB, and the size of the proposed filter is 22 <tex>$\mathrm{x} \ 22 \ \mathrm{x} \ 6 \ {\mathrm{m}}\mathrm{m}^{3}$</tex>, an overall size of 60 <tex>$\times 60 \times 6 \ \text{mm}^3$</tex>.

articleTitle: Cloning an Image using Hybrid Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In the modern era majority of the people are addicted to social media. People are more interested towards keeping profile pictures in their social media sites due to some abuse of their images by some people.This article explores and implements how an image looks like after converting in to cartoon with different face expressions and pencil art. Previous work on cartoon image conversion and pencil art conversion was developed for only cartoon images but no edge clarity and richness in edge quality and discontinuous lines with no face expression change. The main goal of this work is to propose a model that dynamically takes the input image from the user and produces the output image of cartoon image with change in face expression and pencil art. This model is implemented using k-means clustering and media pipe for face mesh to identify the multiple face landmarks for cartoon conversion and scipy is used for converting the image in to pencil art. And streamlit an open-source framework is used for developing this model. This model allows user to choose the type of conversion and give an input an image so that it produces the output of either pencil art or cartoon image with face expression conversion.

articleTitle: Best Suitable Routing Protocol for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A Mobile Ad Hoc Network is one kind of wireless communication networks. MANET is an unplanned network having number of versatile nodes. This node interacts with each other without any fixed infrastructure. In MANET nodes are versatile, each node act as a router and send data from source to destination. Due to dynamic topology of the MANET, it undergoes under several attacks. There are various ways to secure MANET but still several attacks are there which will slow down the performance of the network. Hence a strong cryptography technique is required to secure communication in the MANET. Network is generated using NS2 platform. AODV, DSDV, OLSR routing protocols are compared with respect to evaluating parameters like PDR, throughput. AODV is suitable for MANET. As a successful data transmission increases the throughput increase.

articleTitle: Design of Strip Loaded Dipole Antenna for RFID Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this paper, a linearly polarized strip loaded dipole antenna is presented for RFID applications. In the proposed design copper strips are used which act as a radiator and resonates at the frequency of 5.8 GHz and 8.9 GHz. Additionally, four horizontal fine strips are attached to the upper and lower halves of both the copper strips and excitation is given to the center of the strip loaded dipole antenna. The proposed antenna acquires the size of <tex>$\boldsymbol{70 \text{mm} \times 70}$</tex> mm. It is showing a maximum peak gain of 3.69 dBi at this resonating frequency of 5.8 GHz. Due to proper impedance matching, a return loss of −31.59 dB is obtained with radiation efficiency of 68.71%. The proposed antenna offers better performance along with the use of cost-effective FR-4 substrate, which may be considered for large scale RFID applications.

articleTitle: Quantitative Soil Analysis using Vis-NIR Spectra
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Soil is one of the key components required for a healthy growth of a plant. Without the proper nourishment of the soil, plant growth can be inconsistent and undernourished. This paper aims at various methods that can be used to measure the contents of soil using spectroscopy. The idea behind the approach of these methods is that they are dry methods, non-destructive, and can be portable and cost-effective. Based on the current scenario, availability of soil testing labs in India is not appropriate to the number of farmers. Numerous districts don't have a soil testing lab and farmers must travel to other districts, thus making this whole process more costly and less mobile. Without the proper information of the quantity of the contents present in the soil, farmers cannot use the adequate pesticide to replenish those contents. Thus, this paper aims on the methods that can make this whole process more feasible to the farmers.

articleTitle: An Efficient Visual Cryptography Approach for Intermodal Biometric Verification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Biometric authentication is one of the important ways of acknowledging an individual using their behavioral and physical characteristics. It can range from fingerprint to an iris or retina image, hand geometry, gait or signature, or some other physiological characteristics. The biometric authentication can be further sub-classified into unimodal and multimodal biometric authentication. The framework of biometrics, which utilizes only one suggestive option for verification is termed unimodal biometric. On the other hand, a lot of research work has been going on for the last two decades on multimodal biometric systems where more than one biometric detail of an individual is collected and used in order to authenticate a person. In other words, it can be said that in a multimodal biometrics system, more than two or sometimes at least two biometric sources of one individual (i.e., iris, dermatoglyphics) are considered and evaluated. In our paper, we have implemented an efficient way of fusing two biometric images (human fused iris image of both two eyes and fused thumb impression of two hands) into one image and converted the color image into a binary image, and used the (2,2) Visual Cryptography Scheme two efficiently create two out of two shares. As part of the reconstruction, we have overlapped the two generated shares to generate the fused image. The fused image was further processed to authenticate the genuine person. The proposed approach reduces storage costs and uses simple steps to implement the project which is easy to understand by non-technical people as well.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of MPPT using Advanced PSO based on Fuzzy Fokker Planck Solution under Partial Shading Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Recent economic surge in the area of renewable energy and owing to climate change has enhanced the production of clean and green solar PV in developing countries. Due limited efficiency of solar PV modules, generating maximum power from solar PV modules has become area of interest for researchers. In order to extract maximum possible power, Solar PV is operated with Maximum power point tracker (MPPT). Operating SPV under partial shading condition along with maximum power point is still a parameter which requires improvement. The paper presents a P & O MPPT based particle swarm optimization with improved search space, which has been optimized using Fuzzy Fokker Planck solution. Here the partial shading condition has been tested under four different concentrations. Validation of the proposed work has been carried out using hardware setup and simulation studies. Simulation results has been carried using MATLAB, and its noticed that the proposed MPPT technique offers higher and better performance in terms of MPP convergence by improving the efficiency of the proposed system under partial shading condition and making the system robust.

articleTitle: Mathematical Analysis of Nature-Inspired Algorithm to Non-Linear Functions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper analyzes the nature-inspired algorithm applied to different non-linear functions. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is applied conventionally (CPSO) and compared with Advanced Particle Swarm Optimization (APSO) with a modified velocity update equation. A detailed analysis of CPSO and APSO demonstrates that the particles reach their optimal value faster and the convergence is quicker.

articleTitle: Electrical Characterization and Sensitivity Analysis of Cavity-based Dielectric Modulated ZnO Nano-structured TFT for Biosensing Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A dielectric-modulated zinc-oxide nano-structured thin-film transistor (DM ZnO TFT) for biosensing applications is proposed in this work. This paper presents electrical characterization and sensitivity analysis of ZnO TFT biosensors with a cavity beneath the gate. Changes in device characteristics, such as transfer and output characteristics, have been observed by varying dielectric constant (K) of neutral biomolecules from 1 to 15. The maximum output drain current (I<inf>DS</inf>) of 56.19 mA/mm was obtained for a cavity filled with biomolecules with a higher dielectric constant (K = 15), which is <tex>$3\times$</tex> higher than the corresponding value of the device when the cavity is filled with the air <tex>$(K=1)$</tex>. The threshold voltage (V<inf>th</inf>) and maximum transconductance (gm) noted for (K = 15) are 47 mV and 11.86 mS/mm, whereas the corresponding values for (K = 1) are 636 mV and 4.35 mS/mm. The sensitivity parameters, such as relative threshold voltage sensitivity (Sv<inf>TH</inf>), transconductance sensitivity (Sg<inf>m</inf>), and output drain current sensitivity (S<inf>IDs</inf>) of the device, are also analyzed for different neutral biomolecules. The maximum Sv<inf>TH</inf> of 92.6%, Sgm of 209.1%, and S<inf>IDS</inf> of 172.6% are obtained for K = 15 with reference to K = 1, illustrating that the proposed device is highly sensitive for biomolecular detection.

articleTitle: A Highly Selective Ultra Wideband Microstrip Filter for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this article, a new ultra-wideband bandpass filter is presented that consists of a rectangular multimode resonator with two identical triangular rings, open stubs, and a rectangular defect ground structure (DGS). The filter has operating frequency between 3.1 to 10.6 GHz with two transmission zeros at the edges of the band, where TZ1 can be controlled. According to simulation results, the maximum insertion loss in the bandpass response is 0.28 dB. The return loss for the whole pass band is seen to be greater than 11.25 dB. The UWB filter is designed on Rogers RO4003C substrate which having a dielectric constant of 3.55 and loss tangent of 0.001. It has been designed with a size of <tex>$30\times 30mm^{2}$</tex> and deviation in the group delay is very minimal in pass band.

Author Keywords: open triangular shape stub and Defected Ground Structure (DGS)

articleTitle: Multimedia Data Transfer using NOMA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: 5G innovation is an impending upheaval, which vows to benefit each part of living souls. 5G advances can give network qualities that are fundamental for various areas. This innovation will take into account expanded adaptability and lower costs. NOMA is perchance the preponderance encouraging radio access algorithm in the cutting-edge remote correspondence. Contrasted with Orthogonal Multiple Access (OMA) strategy, NOMA offers advantages like upgraded range proficiency, low idleness and different network. The possibility of NOMA is to serve different clients involving similar asset with regards to time, recurrence and space. This project proposes an idea to transfer the multimedia data using Power Domain NOMA. Transferring the data with low latency. In this work Quadrature Amplitude Modulation and Superposition Encoding scheme is used. Study about various noise channels, channel models is made and compared them. The noise that is being added is AWGN. Developed a code for multimedia data transfer in ideal situation considering the generalized flow chart of the wireless communication.

articleTitle: Gan-Based Face Aging System with Dynamic Age Intervals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This article explores and implements what a person looks like at different ages. Age affects every inch of the body. Along with the wisdom, experience, and accomplishments that come with aging, so too does our appearance. The change in our faces is of utmost importance. The facial aging system has a variety of uses, including finding lost children, chasing criminals, etc. Previous work on facial aging systems was developed by training a generator in a GAN to static ages such as 00–10, 11–20, and 21–30. The main goal of this work is to propose a model that dynamically determines age groups according to user requirements. In this paper, we implemented a model of GAN for every single age instead of groups of ages. This paper uses the Tkinter object which is a slider that allows the user to select the starting age and next age interval. The output of this model is a set of images for user-specified age groups.

articleTitle: Modeling and Performance Analysis of an Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: As compared with fuel-powered vehicles, electric vehicles are more efficient in energy saving, emission reduction and environmental protection. This work present the modelling of Electric Vehicle (EV) and it's performance analysis including battery charging and discharging conditions. Employing result, it is becoming most important with more applications in the transportation sector. The presented work for EV modeling is implemented using MATLAB/Simulink to study and analyze various parameters' impacts on vehicle performances. Finally, the results analysis are presented based on vehicle modeling, driver input and battery charging and discharging behavior.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Quad Bike For Physically Challenged Person
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A Quad-chair pro - sports wheelchair, is an attempt to make a wheelchair powered electrically for the physically challenged people corresponding to almost 6% of the world population, estimating approximately 200 million, facing challenges to drive speedy vehicles in roads which are worst affected or with uneven surfaces. Thereby this project makes it convenient for them to travel faster, save time and reduce their dependency on other individuals in boarding public transports or travelling form one place to another. It is designed with the intentions of providing high speed, high safety, reliability and eco-friendly measures. It can be partially or fully automated depending on an individual's degree of impairment and needs.

articleTitle: Analysing the Shortest Path between the Source and Rental House Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The development of civilization is the foundation of the increase in demand for homes day by day. And also, the major issue is moving once it involves massive cities. The house costs square measure a big consider deciding that house to pick from a variety of homes. It ought to embody all potential factors like the rooms, sq. feet, article of furniture offered, water availableness, parking availableness, etc. At the identical time, it's necessary to incorporate everyone of the foremost factors, which is the distance of travel. it is necessary to analyze and implement the most effective shortest path rule which can calculate the shortest path with the best accuracy and potency. For this, we'd like the assistance of Google maps to find and denote the shortest path with high accuracy. we tend to must also put together the Google Map API with the most effective rule to calculate the shortest path. It becomes useless if the Map shows the shortest path to only one house. Thus, it becomes necessary to calculate the shortest path to all or any of the homes from a location specified it permits the users to analyze and effectively compare the various selections offered to them keeping the space of travel in mind as that is one of every of the foremost price-saving factors. during this literature survey, we are going to study the various algorithms offered and compare them and implement the foremost apt ones in our project.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Design of Solar-powered Irrigation System based on Penman-Monteith Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The evolution of technology is very fast changing and becomes a major factor in globalization. In the field of farming, multiple technologies have been introduced and tried to alleviate the farming difficulties brought by the current era of climate change but one of the most pressing problems for our farming sector is how to utilize the resources available in a more cost-friendly way such as the utilization of renewable energy based on actual conditions present on their farming area. The Philippines is annually devastated by typhoons resulting in property and infrastructure damages, one of which is the irrigation system. According to National Irrigation Authority, many irrigation facilities has been established in 1963, and currently, most farmers are adapting the pump irrigation system as an alternative because of the accumulated damages from natural calamities. This study aims to provide a design that can be used and adapted by our local farmers to cut their process costs, especially in the use of their diesel pump system with an alternative photovoltaic pump system. This paper presents a design of a solar-powered irrigation system based on the Penman-Monteith model of evapotranspiration to provide an alternative but reliable solution for the problems identified.

articleTitle: An Approach for Detection of Epileptic Seizures from EEGs Considering Ictal-like Non-Ictal Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In the clinical diagnosis and treatment of epilepsy, it is a necessity to detect epileptic seizures automatically and accurately from the electroencephalography (EEG) data instead of manual detection. In most studies on this issue, the problem is simply regarded as a binary classification problem to distinguish ictal and non-ictal signals. However, EEG signals actually show characteristics of multimodal distribution, which should not be ignored in the detection. With consideration of the existence of such signals, a new workflow employing a k nearest neighbor algorithm and a generative adversarial network (GAN) is presented. The latter is developed to discern the ictal-like non-ictal EEGs before training the classifier. The GAN is used to find more implicit boundary-type samples. Consider the current task, a 16-layer CNN, which is the type most used to identify patterns in images and video, is transferred here to solve the problems of insufficient training data, long training time, and insufficient accuracy. Evaluated by a public EEG dataset, it proved effective to distinguish boundary signals prior to the classification of ictal and non-ictal signals.

articleTitle: Computer Technology Based on the Intelligentization of College English Cross-cultural Practice
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the reform and development of education, colleges and universities have adopted cross-cultural teaching methods in English teaching, which has effectively improved the quality of college English teaching. This article mainly analyzes the significance of early English teaching in cross-cultural teaching. It also studies the cultivation of cross-cultural competence of English talents based on computer technology, and it also studies the design of computer-based cross-cultural practice and intelligent college English teaching mode. The cross-cultural English teaching model has played an important role in the reform of English teaching.

articleTitle: Efficient Digital Assistant Workflow for Ticket Monitoring and Dispatching
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In a larger cloud operation team, there are groups working on Monitoring and Dispatching whose primary work is monitoring the ticket queue, understanding the ticket, and assigning it to a respective workgroup. In a shift, at least one colleague must be working in the Monitoring and Dispatching role, and in most scenarios, it's an if-else work. In S/4HANA, we hire people specifically for the Monitoring and Dispatching role, contributing to the total cost of ownership. It's not quality work for the people working on the Monitoring and Dispatching role. To solve this problem, we can develop a solution that can understand the sentiment of the tickets, know about the workgroups in a team, and assign them automatically. If we can achieve this, we can reduce the total cost of ownership, provide quality work to our colleagues, avoid manual misses, and have intelligent and optimized dispatching. The vision is to build a Digital assistant with continuous ticket monitoring, intelligent ticket dispatching based on the user workload, and understanding the context of the ticket to give more insights about the ticket like any similar issues solved, what the solution provided last time, and who solved the similar issue last time.

articleTitle: Investigation of Single Shot Ice Accretion on Aerofoil of Wind turbine Blade using ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Icing climate have a various effect on wind energy generation such as increase in the aerodynamic load and weight on turbine blades which is the cause of less rotational speed of rotor. This arises the need of the ice prediction on blades. The deposition of ice on turbine blades affects the shape of airfoil, increase the drag force rather than lift which ultimately becomes the cause of less power output. The ice deposition is serious concern for the countries with super cold weather as in these regions power generation through wind have more challenges like less efficiency, more power losses due to the change in shape of blade profile. This paper contains the numerical solution to predict the ice formation and acceleration on wind turbine blade. The ice deposition is detected using Extended Messinger method and the numerous parameters which describe the wind turbine analysis such as wind speed, tip speed ratio, liquid water content in air is also calculated. The predicted ice shape of airfoil NACA 4412, with the 68m/s wind velocity which generates approximately 5MW wind power is considered in this paper and analysis is done by using ANSYS software by cad processor, solver method and post processor method. Moreover, in this paper the process of ice frosted on blades and its effects on blade performance after icing is presented.

articleTitle: Design of Miniatured Hexagonal Antenna for RFID Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This article introduces a miniatured, hexagonal-shaped, linearly polarised patch antenna for RFID applications. The hexagonal patch antenna is designed to operate at Industrial, Scientific and Medical (ISM) band of 2.45 GHz. The miniaturization is obtained by cutting a pair of fine rectangular slits in the hexagon-shaped patch, which is responsible for the capacitance being generated between the slits and the patch. Moreover, due to impedance loading, there is a decrease in the resonating frequency falling under the ISM band frequency. The proposed antenna provides bandwidth over the frequency range from 2.43-2.48 GHz, which actually reduces the probability of the other interfering signals. The simulated radiation characteristics provides a gain of 2.73 dBi at 2.45 GHz. To briefly describe about the working property of antenna, it is designed in the ISM band or free band, to be used as RFID readers and also the same patch antenna can be implemented as an on-body applications.

articleTitle: Micromachined Varactors with High Tuning Ratio using Electrostatic and Piezoelectric Actuation Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Radio frequency (RF) components based on Microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) are being utilized for a variety of microwave and millimeter-wave applications. This paper presents the design and analysis of MEMS varactor for microwave applications. The MEMS varactors are designed to meet the demands of high tuning range, High Q and large bandwidth requirements. The designed varactors have been analysed for different materials with different mechanical suspensions as well as two different actuation mechanism to optimize the design for high performance. The varactors are designed and simulated in COMSOL MULTIPHYSICS tool. Several designs of electrostatic actuated varactor and piezoelectric actuated varactor models were proposed. The best tuning range obtained through electrostatic actuated varactor was 15.95:1 and that of the piezoelectrically actuated was 21.64:1. The frequency analysis of the models was performed using ANSYS HFSS tool. Several materials were incorporated for the models and same have been analysed using the simulation tools.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Intracranial Hemorrhage through an EfficientNetB7-based UNET model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A serious threat to human life is posed by intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH), which is common and has a terrible prognosis. For the purpose of aiding in the identification and medication of ICH, the segmentation of the bleeding using CT imaging plays a crucial part. In this research, an EfficientNet-B7-based U-Net architecture was implemented to improve the segmentation accuracy. Here the EfficientNet is replaced in the encoder part of the basic U-Net model. We used it, particularly because it uses the concept of compound scaling and achieved the highest accuracy in the ImageNet classification challenge with fewer model parameters. The proposed model is evaluated with the ADAM optimizer and attained the Dice value of 0.73 and Jaccard Index of 0.63 respectively. To evaluate the proposed model the database was collected from the PhysioNet which consists of a total of 2500 slices.

articleTitle: Plant Growth Recommendation System based on Weather Conditions and Soil Patterns using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Generally, cropping patterns are mostly supported by climate and also on the composition of the soil. So, selecting the crop that supports the upcoming climate conditions and is suitable for the type of land chosen, we are able to yield better than other crops and increase our profits. In recent years, researchers have run missions like prediction and soil composition testing. By taking into consideration the available data, our study evaluates an outsized range of weather figure methods, soil composition methods, and methods for determining the foremost effective cropping pattern. Due to changing climatic conditions and soil compositions, determining exact cropping patterns has become a difficult issue. This survey examines various machine learning, deep learning, and neural network methodologies for this project.

articleTitle: Modelling of Vehicle for Showing Various Effects of Wind and Terrain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The automotive industry is moving toward environmentally friendly automobiles, such as electric vehicles, in the future years (EV). This has inspired a lot of researchers to use diverse multidisciplinary approaches to create electric car technology. It entails the creation of a suitable electronic control system needed to ensure an effective power flow across connected batteries and motors. Initial testing of tractive efforts is required for the right motor selection. In order to illustrate how wind and topography might affect a vehicle's body, this paper will define a Simulink model of an electric car and include forces such as aerodynamics, rolling resistance, and acceleration (linear and angular acceleration). The study's main objective is to demonstrate the results using the MATLAB platform, and the performance validation is contrasted with other cases.

Author Keywords: Simulation and Modeling of EV for wind and terrain effect

articleTitle: Visualization of Sea Water Intrusion along the Coast of Krishna and Godavari Delta
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Seawater is being pushed inland by spatiotemporal changes in coastal zones, and vice versa. Seawater intrudes beneath freshwater by diminishing fresh groundwater head at the transition zone as a result of coastal erosion, which removes sediments from the near shore at a large distance. The influx of seawater into fresh water aquifers as a result of natural or manmade processes is referred to as sea water intrusion. Groundwater levels dropping or sea levels rising both lead to seawater intrusion. The availability or quality of source water for drinking water utilities may be compromised by saltwater intrusion. Salinity interferes with the intake of nitrogen, which stunts growth, affecting agricultural and tree yield. In this project, coastal changes are analysed using a change detection algorithm (a GIS method) and heat maps are shown.

articleTitle: Spectral Estimation of ElectroGastroGram Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In this study the various spectral estimation of the Electrogastrogram Signals are discussed. The Main objective of the study is to identify the gastroparesis condition using various signal processing techniques. Gastroparesis is one of the pathetic condition in which the stomach fails to digest. Gastroparesis is also called as stomach paralysis. Due to damage or dysfunction of vagal nerve, kajal cells at stomach lining temporary stomach paralysis happen. The immediate stimulation can make the pacemaker of the stomach to get activated and back to digestion process. In this study the stomach signals are preprocessed and spectral estimation techniques are applied to study about the signal spectrum characteristics. The determination of dominant frequencies and features extracted from frequency domain gives vivid description about the abnormalities of the gastric signal.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms*
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The heart is an important organ in living creatures. Heart disease detection and diagnosis require extreme precision, completeness, and accuracy because even a minor inaccuracy can result in tiredness or death. There are numerous incidences of death linked to the heart, and the number is rapidly increasing. A forecast system for illness awareness is necessary to solve the problem. Machine learning is a sort of intelligent machines that uses natural occurrences like training to help anticipate any type of event.of resolution, line reversal, and vector support mechanism (SVM). Anaconda (jupytor) notebook is an excellent tool for launching the Python program as it has a variety of libraries and files in the head making the task clearer and more accurate.

articleTitle: A Navigation LSC Boat driven by Renewable
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: India is a waterborne country. Nowadays it is very essential to replace fossil fuel-dependent boats with renewable energy-based boats to minimize the power scarcity issue as well as to contain environmental pollution. In rural areas communication is based on the ferry boats. Many areas of the tourism sector on riverside can luminescent solar concentrator(LSC) based solar electric boats which can be a great attraction for the user. Tourism will contribute economic as well as environmental growth of the country by using such innovative LSC-based solar electric boats. The concept of wind and solar electrical boats is proposed in this paper by considering tourist's transport on the coast side, in rivers and lakes. This work endeavors to set up technical as well as cost-effective features of a standalone application as self-dependent generation boat with a boost converter will feed the DC load (DC shunt motor). The whole photo voltaic solar source power will be extracted and fed to the solar electrical boat via a boost converter which is sufficient to drive the boat. The solar electrical boat using the boost converter model is simulated through MATLAB software and is compared with the theoretical indications. Such solar-powered electrical boats can be used in Namami Gange Project, India to minimize the fuel crisis issue.

articleTitle: Classification of Quantum Graph State Codes using Decision Trees
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Graph states are multipartite quantum states that exhibit rich entanglement because of their topology. We consider graph states for studying a family of quantum error correcting codes such as <tex>$[[n,\ 1,\ d]]$</tex> encoding one logical qubit into <tex>$n$</tex> physical qubits of the graph state. We investigate the impact of edge connectivity on the minimum <tex>$d$</tex> of the resulting graph state codes (GSCs).

articleTitle: Study of container-based JupyterLab and AI Framework on HPC with GPU usage
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Container technologies enable portability and reproducibility for applications. A containerized application or service can be quickly prototyped, built, and deployed. Artificial Intelligence (AI) workloads with large datasets are driven by High Performance Computing (HPC) with Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) usage to expedite solving more complex real-world problems. The most widely used container technology is Docker, but due to the root access needed to run Docker containers and related security issues, it cannot be easily adopted in secure HPC systems. Singularity meets the needs of the HPC environment and permits the use of identical Docker containers without alterations to address security issues. This work presents an approach for execution of container-based JupyterLab and AI framework with workload manager using user credentials on HPC with GPU usage. We provide comprehensive performance evaluations of JupyterLab and AI framework containers transformed from Docker to Singularity to solve more complex real-world problems with GPU in an HPC environment in the context of native.

articleTitle: Experimental Verification and Deep Learning Classification of A-V and V-A Methods for Resistance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: For measurement of electrical resistance or power, there are two methods namely Ammeter-Voltmeter(A-V) and Voltmeter-Ammeter (V-A) methods which are being extensively used in laboratories and field however there are certain concerns of which method is preferred based on the value of resistance (Low, medium, high) or power (high, medium or low). This work is aimed at identifying the best suitable method for low, medium and high-power measurement. Laboratory experiments are conducted for different values of power or resistance and the observations are recorded up to a maximum of 3 kW. Validation is done with the help of standard mathematical equations to identify the best method for measurements with less error. Also, Deep Learning Classifier is used to know the accuracy of proposed method and a prediction algorithm is formulated to know the type of method to be used for the given power or resistance. Final conclusions are drawn by mentioning the type of method to be used for each resistance or power.

articleTitle: An adavanced Gesture Recognition Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A hand gesture recognition system is a good idea to work interaction with a computer system, so that we can make a machine that will take some kind of snaps and perform actions accordingly, the focus on gesture motion is to develop a system for better communication between humans and computers. This paper presents a systematic study of all last year's papers for 2016 to 2019. It displays every technique that was employed to recognize hand gestures. A thorough survey of the scientific literature on gestures movement that deals with touch-free computing machines in the adjacent surroundings. This method includes touchless gesture interaction. Around 50 papers were identified and analyzed of them, and from there only 20 papers I found the same concept of gesture motion. Most of the identified literature (62%) deals with the control of gesture motion. Another one offers interactive methods for various types of notions. In the last few years back touchless interaction with computer system approaches. Though few were examined systematically in the real world and the rest of the other placed a different priority on the topic. Further research is required to cope with the current limitations of touchless interaction. The main challenges for future research are the improvement and evaluation of usability and touchless human-computer interaction and the further development of hands-free interaction. The accuracy was 96.67%, recall 98.73%, F1 measure 98.23%, and throughput 97.82% had been attained which is a good improvement.

Author Keywords: Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis (PRISMA)

articleTitle: HealthCare MisInformation Detection on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Recently, the employment of social networks like Facebook Associate in Nursing and Twitter became an indivisible part of our daily lives. However, whereas folks get pleasure from social networks, several deceptive activities like faux news or rumors will mislead users into basic cognitive process info. Besides, spreading a large quantity of info on social networks has become a world risk. Therefore, info detection (MID) in social networks has gained an excellent deal of attention Associate in nursing is taking into account a rising space of analysis interest. there's a requirement to develop automatic solutions which will aid each consultant and non-experts in differentiating between reliable and unreliable health data as a result of tending is one of the foremost vital and pressing topics in our society. several malicious things regarding health square measure unfold that square measure unreliable and folks believe that to mislead that data.

articleTitle: Implementation of Synthetic Artificial Human Like Voice Over Robotic Voice
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The creation of social robots has steadily increased during the past 20 years. Social robots differ from regular industrial robots such that they are meant to work closely with people in collaborative settings as opposed to frequently replacing people in labor-intensive tasks. Social robots are now much more prevalent in a variety of areas of the human life, including social well being, providing entertainment, and medical contexts, as well as in business and education. Roboticists are attempting to create social robots that replicate human look, behaviour, and emotional expression in these applications. The subject of how people perceive and react to social robots, particularly in terms of voice, is raised by the fact that these machines are becoming more and more integrated into people's lives. In this paper, we are going to review the literature on the communication part of the social robots and specifically the voice part which plays a key role in the Human Robot Interaction.

articleTitle: Biopotential Acquisition Systems: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Clinical analysis of bioelectric signals acquired from human bodies is critical in the diagnosis of a variety of diseases. The rising population in the modern era creates demand for non-clinical interpretation of biopotential signals with improved signal quality due to their busy schedule. Non-clinical monitoring necessitates reductions in size, power consumption, occupied area, and signal quality. With the upheavals in CMOS technology, the performance of Integrated circuits has been improving exponentially. Minimization of sizes will ameliorate the speed of the device and bring down its power consumption. In the ASIC design of prolonged battery-operated devices, a biopotential acquisition system having a low-power readout front-end, filter, and compressed sensing analog to information converter is presented. Mixed-signal processor is implemented for biopotential preprocessing with high noise immunity and reduced size. In this paper, the comparative analysis of low-power, low-noise bipotential acquisition units, and the sub-units are scrutinized by which comfortable biopotential acquisition systems will extend their usage towards non-clinical applications.

articleTitle: Weighted Cause-Reward Analysis-based Reinforcement Learning Method for Optimizing the Sentiment Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In online markets or shops, the products are purchased by people based on their visual appearance and textual description. These ecommerce systems also collect user views or feedback about the sold product or services. The user also submits his complaints, reaction, and opinion including his sentiments. These reviews can be processed by ecommerce sites to rank their products and identify the features and flaws of products. In this paper, a weighted cause-reward analysis-based reinforcement learning method is proposed to optimize the sentiment classification. The model first transformed the input reviews to the weighted features by identifying the frequency and boundness with product. These weighted features are processed by the reinforcement learning method to classify the sentiments. The model is applied on the reviews collected from amazon reviews dataset. The analysis results are compared against machine learning and deep learning methods. The results shows that the proposed model achieved the average accuracy rate of 94.60% which is significantly better than existing methods. The performance and reliability of the system are improved by the proposed model.

articleTitle: Law Enforcement Companion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Identifying absconding criminals after committing an offence or illegal act is a time consuming and tedious task. Seeing the current growing population density and considering the vastness of the land area any country has, it is very difficult for law enforcement agencies alone to do this task. So public involvement becomes extremely significant, game-changer and helpful. According to many reports, finding lawbreakers by causing different individuals from the office to sit with PCs and PCs to look through the CCTV film to find and follow the blameworthy, as they don't have the robotized framework for doing this errand with them. This cycle is both times and works seriously. In this paper, we have attempted to review the current advancements as well as propose another framework for criminal Distinguishing & Recognition using Deep learning and Heroku Cloud i.e Cloud Computing, which assuming utilized by our Crime control Organizations would assist them with tracking down crooks from the pictures of CCTV or images uploaded by the public if seen anywhere. This system if implemented helps find criminals as well as any person can upload the information that he has seen the required person in a particular place and time. Existing arrangements utilize conventional face acknowledgement calculations which can be problematic in changing Indian conditions, particularly factors like light, climate and particular direction and there is no open public contribution. All the workload and pressure will be upon the Law Enforcing Agencies only. This research paper proposes to use Deep Learning and the Heroku Cloud systems for the implementation of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Interior PMSM for E-Loader Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) use motors that are easy to regulate, have a wide constant power operating zone, have high power density, and have cheap production costs. The 2D style of the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor is still being developed, and the design simulation was done with all electrical vehicle characteristics. The preliminary type of motor was completed in RMxpt in accordance with the design parameters for the rotor/stator using Ansys Maxwell. On the basis of Field- oriented vector control and space vector pulse-width modulation, a simulation model for the driving circuit, two controllers (speed and current controller), and the position detection of the rotor were constructed. The main goal is to better our current understanding of the permanent magnet (PM) motor's architecture. The results of the device are validated using both the fundamental needs for EVs and the gadget's future proto-model. In order to accurately depict the performance of the drive had to be more realistic, a joint simulation of the PMSM and the vector control system was added to the analysis from the PMSM control system developed on the Ansys software during magnetic analysis.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Power Efficient 1-bit Adder circuits in 18 nm FinFET Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Implantable electronics demand for ultra-low power techniques at nanometer regime. Due to limitations of CMOS technology new logic circuit using next generation devices are required to be developed. In this work, FinFET based one-bit adder circuits are designed using Complementary FinFET Technique (CFT) and Complementary Pass Transistor Logic (CPTL) in 18 nm FinFET technology. The results show values of Power Delay Product (PDP) and Energy Delay Product (EDP) for CFT based one-bit adder circuit are 6905. <tex>$130 \mathrm{x}10^{-15}$</tex> and <tex>$6981.565 \mathrm{x} 10^{-22}$</tex> respectively. Whereas, values of PDP and EDP for CPTL based one-bit adder circuit are <tex>$6460 \mathrm{x}10^{-15}$</tex> and <tex>$6137 \mathrm{x}10^{-22}$</tex>. CPTL based design is showing better efficiency in terms of power and energy delay product. The FinFET based CPTL adder circuit outlined in this work are expected be used in low-power portable and implantable biomedical systems.

articleTitle: Automatic Landslide Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: One of the most frequent natural disasters is a landslide. It is defined as the downward movement of soil and rock due to gravitational force. It leads to loss of people and property. So, landslide detection plays a crucial role in saving people's life. In this project work, we took sentinel-l satellite dataset of Kodagu(formally known as Coorg) in Karnataka, India. The images are pre-processed using CLAHE(Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization) and pixels based classification will be applied to extract the low-level features. The image background is removed by Digital Elevation Model(DEM). Using morphological analysis, the small objects that distinguish landslides from another are removed by taking maxima and minima points. Landslides are detected from that image using H-BEMD(Hue-Bi-Directional Empirical Mode Decomposition). H-BEMD is the improved version of BEMD(Bi-Directional Empirical Mode Decomposition) along with Hue Channel.

Author Keywords: Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) algorithm

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Drive with Half Bridge Configuration based Bidirectional DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: With the potential to substantially reduce carbon emissions and pave the path for considerable climate progress, electric vehicles can transform the transportation sector for the better. But there are several significant obstacles that this developing sector must overcome. Charging time, charger compatibility, availability of charging infrastructure, renewable energy, grid capacity, power converters are some of these challenges. An efficient power conditioning system plays a significant role in the design of battery charging systems for electric vehicles. Every new vehicle that is released in the market has motors with improved efficiency and higher power density. This results in a higher input voltage to the drive motor. On the other hand, the batteries have a lower nominal voltage due to the need to connect the cell strings in parallel. This is necessary to improve the redundancy of the backup system and reduce problems related to charge imbalance. Therefore, a bidirectional DC-DC buck and boost converter is required between the motor/inverter and the battery. This DC-DC converter forms an important part of the electric vehicle power train. It manages the flow of power, transforms the voltage level of energy storage devices, and controls charge/discharge currents to maintain the state of energy storage devices. In this current work, a non-isolated bidirectional DC-DC converter with half-bridge configuration, operating in both directions, is considered. Converter and controller design and modelling are presented. The closed-loop operation of the converter is demonstrated when powering a DC motor during steady-state operation and during vehicle acceleration. Energy recovery during regenerative braking is also demonstrated. The effectiveness of the system is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Silicon based Bi-Core Photonic Crystal Fiber Glucose Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Glucose is essential for energy potential in human being. This glucose should be in specific range, if exceeds or decreases in an individual will create health issues. This work proposes Bi-core PCF glucose sensor to sense glucose level which is numerically investigated through Finite Element Method. D-glucose concentration from 60% and 64% is sensed which are filled inside two cores. Minimum confinement loss and with sensitivity of 20,000nm/RIU is attained.

articleTitle: Enhanced Wideband Photoresponse and Detectivity in In2S3/CIGS Heterojunction Based Photodetector
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A detailed multiphysics (optical, electrical) simulation of a In2S3 - CIGS heterojunction-based photodetector has been presented. We employed the Ansys LUMERICAL Multiphysics tool for numerical simulation, which provides an automated process for executing device-level simulations and computes important outcomes including dark and photocurrents, responsivity, and bandwidth. CIGS is a potential light-harvesting material for wide-area broadband photodetection, despite the fact that it has not received much investigation. Our proposed work shows the broadband photosensitivity of the photodiode with responsivity over 0.8 AW-1, external quantum efficiency above 100% and detectivity over 1012Jones within 400nm to 1000 nm when fed to a bias voltage of 1V. It was observed that CIGS based photodetector demonstrated ability to detect even weak light.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation on Silicon based Hollow Core Photonic Crystal Fiber for sensing Multiple Virus
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: In recent years, spread of infection due to virus became whirlwind and creates threat to life in multiple ways. Hence there is in need to sense virus as early as possible in easier way. In this work we propose a multi virus sensor which senses IBV, H5N1, H9N2, and H4N6.Very low refractive index is sensed in this work with increased birefringence due to its elliptical core, where the samples are infiltrated. Numerical analysis is done using Finite Element Method. Among these 4 viruses, IBV has higher sensitivity, birefringence and lower confinement loss which belong to COVID family.88.56% of sensitivity is obtained at 1550nm with low confinement loss.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic-Socio Impact Analysis of Solar PV on Householders Rooftop in Riyadh City, Saudi Arabia
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The household sector in Saudi Arabia consumes the most electricity, accounting for over half of the country's overall consumption. Since Saudi Arabia relies primarily on natural resources. As a result, environmental pollution and the sustainability of the energy supply are become the key issues. Therefore, Saudi government is working to maximize the use of renewable energy sources for power generation in an effort to reduce these issues. This paper examines the techno-socio-economic effects of rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) systems that are connected to the grid while considering a number of variables, including load consumption, export tariff, and electricity tariff. Also, provides a technical examination of the performance of rooftop solar PV systems using the System Advisor Model (SAM) software. A rooftop solar PV system's installation and maintenance costs were analysed over the course of the PV system's lifespan. The economic assessment considers Saudi Arabia's most recent regulations for residential solar PV systems, which let consumers to generate and export excess energy to the utility grid. The final section also depended on the publication of questionnaires with various questions in Riyadh City. These inquiries focused on community members' readiness to adopt such technologies and their varying levels of expectations.

articleTitle: Study of Feature Extraction Techniques for BCI Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Brain computer interface (BCI) is used to identify electrical activity in human brain using the electroencephalog-raphy (EEG). EEG records the electrical activity by placing the electrodes on the scalp. By using the recorded information it will able to classify the different types of abnormalities happening in brain. For extracting the information from signal without losing any information, some feature extraction methods have been used using deep learning concepts. The methods are Time Frequency distribution, Fast Fourier Transform, Eigen Vector, Wavelet Transform, Auto Regressive, Independent Component Analysis, Principal Component Analysis, Empirical Method Decomposition, Hilbert Huang Transform and Local Discriminant bases. Comparison have been done between the methods to show how effectively methods without losing an information. The classification accuracies of the feature methods are compared with each other. The study concluded the hybrid methods such as domain specific and automated features togeather shown better performance.

articleTitle: A Wideband Frequency Selective Surface EM Absorber using Lossy Material for X and Ku band Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A wideband frequency selective surface (FSS) absorber implementing lossy ink layer for electromagnetic absorption is presented in this paper. The absorber is designed on a metallic ground plane which acts as reflector. A thin layer of lossy ink material is used in the form of double square loops which serves as an absorber at the top surface of the substrate. The FSS unit cell has an overall size of <tex>$18\mathbf{mm x }18\mathbf{mm x }0.8\mathbf{mm}$</tex> with outer and inner square loops whose dimensions are 15mm and 10 mm, respectively. The results show that the proposed absorber operates between 8 GHz to 14 GHz covering X and lower Ku bands. It is shown that this design provides a fractional bandwidth of 54.5% and 98% absorptivity in the whole band. The wideband and high absorptivity of the proposed FSS absorber demonstrates its potential for electronic warfare and other strategic applications.

articleTitle: Design of Computer Decision Support System for Labor Education Evaluation in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Labor education in Colleges and universities is a comprehensive quality education with the content of Cultivating College Students' abilities in related aspects such as concepts, emotions, will, knowledge and skills, the goal of improving relevant quality and quality, meeting the needs of society for knowledge-based, skilled and innovative labor talents, and the value pursuit of carrying forward the spirit of labor and cultivating labor models. The design of computer decision support system for labor education evaluation in Colleges and universities is the process of designing a computer system to assist in the management, monitoring and evaluation of students' performance. The goal is to improve the quality and effectiveness of teaching, learning, evaluation and other activities related to academic teaching. In addition to supporting the teaching delivery of a college or University (for example, by providing information about the progress of students' graduation), it can also be used as a management tool to support institutional policies, such as setting class size limits or determining whether courses meet the minimum standards for inter agency credit transfer.

articleTitle: Active Cell Balancing Using Isolated Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study of cell-to-cell Active Voltage Cell Balancing using a Flyback converter and a Multi-winding Forward converter. Both converters have high-frequency switching transformers. Primary and secondary windings of both converters are isolated. The working principle of both converters is similar. The summation of voltage of each cell connected across secondary windings gets transferred to primary windings through switching. From a primary winding average of energy gets redistributed to all cells across secondary windings. The balancing time of each converter is compared and limitations of Flyback converter are discussed. The results are obtained through MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Cooperative Adaptive Control Of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle With Inconsistent Parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: This paper considers the adaptive synchronization problem of a class of unmanned aerial vehicle with inconsistent parameters. An adaptive controller is designed using Barbalat lemma and adaptive control method. The update law of the system is given to design the parameters of the response system, and a criterion is given to ensure that the dynamic behaviors of the main system and the response system are globally synchronized. This criterion is in terms of linear matrix inequality, which can be checked by MATLAB - LMI toolbox. The simulation results show the effectiveness and applicability of proposed method.

articleTitle: Formation of Autonomous Campus Microgrid with E-Tap Simulations and Validation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The demand for more and more utilisation of renewable energy is increasing. Also, the self-efforts to form microgrids are tremendous than too far self-powered microgrids. To this effect, this work is done to form an autonomously powered campus microgrid. The annual average load is taken for design and formation of autonomous microgrid. Detailed estimates are made component wise and a balance between supply and demand is arrived. Simulations are carried out on and validations are done with E-Tap, the power system analysis software. Finally, conclusions are drawn about formation of self-powered campus microgrid.

articleTitle: Optimizing Video Conferencing Web Application built on WebRTC
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Web RTC can provide real time capabilities for multimedia applications like voice, video and data between peers by utilizing the open standards. With the onset of covid, video conferencing has become a need of the day. Optimization of bandwidth, and other features have become the necessity. In the current work, WebRTC protocols are built upon, to improve the connection and success rate, optimize the bitrate and reduce the frame rate. This improvement is carried out without visible or audible loss of clarity in the video sessions. The Session Description Protocol is utilized to accomplish this, and this would not have been possible using WebRTC APIs alone. N-to-N connection among peers is established in an optimized manner, so that the application does not engage an intermediate server to transfer media streams which has resulted in multi-fold improvement in bandwidth performance and also maximized the number of participants, without incurring the cost for an intermediate media server. Conventionally, an intermediate media server is used to stitch streams from various senders into a single stream and then sent to the receivers. Bandwidth utilization is reduced close to 100x with good visibility in the stream. Robust web application is achieved using the TURN (Traversal Using Relays around NAT) server. The proposed work has addressed multiple ways of optimizing for the video conferencing using WebRTC.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Sliding Mode Controller based PMBLDC Motor to improve the performance parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: An FLSMC speed control system is proposed for use in PMBLDC motor within the scope of this paper. The high-speed control of BLDC motors is accomplished with the help of a fuzzy sliding mode controller. The efficacy of the system can be increased with the help of an FSM controller. PI controllers are not applicable to BLDC motors because of the non-linear features that they possess. The Interval Type2 fuzzy PID controller has a tough time dealing with noise disturbances, harmonics, and uncertainty caused by either their antecedents or their consequents. Sliding Mode Control, on the other hand, is the most appealing control strategy for all kinds of uncertainties, and it also increases the performance of the system. A successful simulation results demonstrated the appealing performance of the projected system.

articleTitle: Sepsis Detection using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The immune system in our body, which is always working to stop the infection from entering, is what causes sepsis. The massive amount of synthetic compounds released into the blood at this stage produces widespread discomfort. An immune reaction to chemicals becomes out of balance which results in sepsis, bringing triggering reactions that can harm various organs. In the patient's case, an essential element is the feasibility of identifying sepsis disease development as the outcome. This work's main objective is to construct and train a Multi-Layer perceptron (MLP) model utilizing data that is currently accessible in the form of digital healthcare data and forecasts whether the result will be classified as a person having sepsis or not based on health records. Comparing the MLP's accuracy against that of many other models or classifier algorithms such as Gradient Boosting, Ada-Boost, and Linear Discriminant Analysis using log loss and metrics is the secondary objective. The proposed system comprises three stages. They are Pre-processing, Feature Importance, and Classification. The datasets used are PhysioNet Challenge data and the MIMIC-III dataset. In the pre-processing stage, the missing values are removed and a resampling technique is applied to the dataset. Feature importance is done with the help of the Xgboost framework to identify the important features. Then models are built using different classifiers to find out the best classifier with high accuracy and detect the sepsis disease in minimal time.

articleTitle: E-Health Monitoring System Application using OLED and Pulse Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: A heartbeat monitoring system application integrated with Blynk Apps, OLED, and pulse sensors is proposed in this paper. Counting the heartbeat in beats per minute (BPM) in a manual way would be time-consuming, especially for a large group of patients and when in an emergency condition. The proposed heartbeat monitoring system is designed to reduce the effort and improve the performance of the current heartbeat monitoring system. The system can capture the pulse rate and use the application to track down every heartbeat condition, with the aid of an IoT system and sensors. The hardware-based Internet of Things (IoT) platform is termed ‘Blynk’ which is basically an amalgamation of machine learning, analytics, private device management, and white-labeled mobile applications. The microcontroller used system in this project would beESP8266 NodeMCU with a built-in Wi-Fi module. The proposed e-health monitoring system can be used for high-intensity workout competitions and training purposes to capture the participants of the heartbeat condition to avoid unprofessional acts that can endanger one's health. Furthermore, the proposed attendance system can save time from queueing up at the clinic or hospital to check heartbeat conditions and wait for consultation, patients can directly use the monitoring system at home and the apps to capture the results.

articleTitle: Comparison of Exclamation Mark Usage as Message Nuances in Digital Chat Communication Between Japanese and Indonesian
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Exclamation mark or kantanfu in Japanese, is one of written language elements used to convey expressions. Based on exclamation mark usage, the meaning and nuance of a sentence could differ. Amidst the COVID19 pandemic that limits one's interaction to another, the frequency of digital communication has significantly increased. Digital communication through chats has become an activity that cannot be separated from everyday life. Therefore, it is important to understand exclamation marks correctly. The aim of this study is to avoid misunderstandings that could happen through chats in Japanese. This study will compare the use and interpretation of exclamation marks in Japanese chat between Indonesians and Japanese. Japanese chat messages containing exclamation marks were analyzed using Hymes' SPEAKING theory. This study uses Creswell's convergent mixed methods, with quantitative data of Indonesians' questionnaire survey results, and qualitative data of interviews with Japanese people. Study results show that there are differences in the use and function of exclamation marks between Indonesians and Japanese.

articleTitle: Analyzing Chemical Degradation of Power Transformers Using Smart Intelligence System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Transformers are the critical components of any power transmission network and are vulnerable to failure for several reasons. The deterioration of the insulation materials used in a power transformer might fail. The prevailing environmental conditions, including temperature, moisture, and oxygen content, affect how quickly the insulation degrades. In this study, a fuzzy based approach is employed to compute the overall chemical degradation of the transformer using crisp input data from multiple diagnostic tests. Here, the chemical degradation of each transformer component is computed, and fuzzy sub-models are constructed using weighted fuzzy rules to increase the model's efficacy. Based on the calculated chemical criticality index, creative fuzzy models are created to compute automatically and suggest the most appropriate action to take.

articleTitle: Data Protection for Backups and Recovery in Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Cloud provides its users with different services. Every day during cloud computing, a great deal of data is generated. The data should be saved on the cloud servers properly. If this data is missing from the server, a mechanism to retrieve this data should be created. This study states one such solution. The proposed scheme would allow the data to be stored simultaneously on the cloud server and the remote server. The data is returned from the remote server when the key file is lost. Secret key security is ensured so that the authentication is secure and authorized by the user based on the attributes of backup and recovery. A cloud is a distinct Information Technology infrastructure designed to provide its users with different facilities that can be accessed remotely. Cloud refers to the term network of networks that support access to decentralized Information Technology resources. Cloud uses the Internet as well as the remote central servers to manage consumers and businessmen's data and applications. This helps to save the consumer from costs and room problems. It is a technology that makes data collection, processing, and bandwidth much more centralized. A cloud has a certain limit, as it is a certain framework used to provide resources remotely. The Internet offers access to a vast number of clouds. Whereas the Internet offers free access to several web-based Information Technology services, a cloud is generally private and provides wireless data resources. Much of the Internet is accessible via the web service to Information Technology services. On the other hand, the Information Technology services supplied by cloud environments are intended to provide back-end computing capabilities and browser access.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Beamforming Algorithm based on FPGA synthesis for MIMO Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: The Multiple Input and Multiple Output (MIMO) system, combined with adaptive beamforming antenna array technology, is prospective to play a significant role in the 5G wireless system. The objective of the beamforming technique is to steer the beam in the necessary direction and to reduce interference in the other direction using an adaptive filter. This paper aims to incorporate the antenna array system into the hardware. Therefore, the adaptive beamforming algorithm is designed, developed and synthesised using Verilog (VHDL) with the Electronic System Level (ESL) System Vue software and ModelSim tool. In this paper, with the help of ESL System Vue software, the intended signal and interfering signals are generated for the Millimeter (mm)-wave frequency, with 8 uniform linear array antennas. These signals are fed to the hardware architecture of the beamforming algorithm. From the result, it is detected that the proposed adaptive beamforming algorithm has better performance when related to the other algorithms.

articleTitle: GPS Bus schedule application system in UCSI University
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
abstract: Nowadays, public transportation, such as the UCSI University shuttle bus service, is an important service that allows students and employees who do not have access to their own transportation to go about their daily activities. The types of bus services, the quality of service in the bus operation that impacts passenger decisions, and the role of the bus provider and bus driver will all be discussed in this article. For a well-managed bus service, a better application will be designed for comprehension of the bus operation. More features, such as predicted bus arrival time and bus reservation, will be added to this application in the future to maintain a high level of quality in service and performance, encouraging people to choose public transportation as their preferred mode of transportation.

articleTitle: Architectural Improvement and Performance Evaluation of 1D-to-2D Array Conversion Priority Encoder
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Smart Generation Computing, Communication and Networking (SMART GENCON)
